jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 Empa, the Swiss Federal Laboratories for Materials Science and Technology, is based in Dübendorf, St. Gallen and Thun, and brings together around 1’100 co-workers from more than 60 nations in an interdisciplinary, international environment with a strong network across academia and industry.

 Women Scientific Leadership Fellowship

 Empa is launching the Women Scientific Leadership Fellowship, a new funding programme to support outstanding women scientists on their path to independent research leadership. The Fellowship gives excellent candidates the resources and hands-on leadership experience to establish themselves as future group leaders at Empa. This is part of our broader commitment outlined in our Diversity Action Plan and relates to specific goals that are regularly implemented, reviewed and further developed.

 What the Fellowship Offers 
 
• A 4-year fellowship, comparable in scope and ambition to an SNF/ERC Starting Grant. 

• Funding for the fellow’s own salary, plus one doctoral (PhD) student position for the fellow to lead and supervise, combining independent research with genuine leadership experience.

• A structured opportunity to build the track record needed for a future, tenure-track group leader role at Empa.
 

 Who Can Apply

 
• Internal or external candidates.

• Internal candidates may apply for a position in their current laboratory or another providing a strategic fit.

• Candidates from industry, provided they have a strong scientific track record.

• Researchers holding a doctorate, with postdoctoral or equivalent independent research experience and an excellent, ambitious research profile that aligns with the strategic direction of one of our research laboratories.
 
 Strategic Requirement 
 This Fellowship is targeted, not open-ended: applications are accepted only where the hosting Empa laboratory has a concrete, realistic prospect of a group-leader-level opening within the next five years. Laboratories without such a prospect are asked not to put forward candidates. Before applying, candidates must secure a letter of support from the relevant lab head confirming this strategic fit.

 How to Apply

 The application package consists of: 
 
• CV and scientific track record.

• A research and leadership plan setting out the objectives, approach, how the project advances the field, and how it builds the candidate’s leadership experience.

• A letter of support from the (prospective) lab head, addressing strategic fit, the prospective opening, mentoring commitment, and continuity plans for the doctoral student. 
 Please upload your full application package via the general Empa jobs portal. Please note that we do not consider applications via email.

 Evaluation 
 Applications are assessed by an evaluation panel against the excellence of the candidate, the excellence and feasibility of the proposed research and leadership plan, and the strategic fit within the host department – criteria comparable to those used for ERC Starting Grants. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to an interview.

 Programme Format and Timeline

 The Fellowship is not a one-off competitive call but an ongoing programme, with two evaluation rounds per year, in January and June.

 
• First round – application deadline: December 31 2026

• First round – evaluation: January 2027

• Places available: Up to 3 fellowships

• Special cases: Can be discussed directly with the programme task for
 

 
 Why Empa 
 
• Internationally recognized science institute with access to excellent research infrastructure and a wide net-work spanning academia and industry.

• A strong, demonstrated commitment to equal opportunities: Empa holds the HR Excellence in Research label and received the Prix Balance ZH award for promoting diversity and work–family life balance.

• Recognition as a top employer: 6th place in the Education & Research category of the 2024 “Best Employer” ranking.
 

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application as mentioned above. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 PhD Position in Bacteria & Materials Interactions

 The Biointerfaces Laboratory at Empa in St. Gallen is offering a PhD position in the field of antimicrobial biomaterials, microbiology, and bacteriophage therapy. The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary research team developing innovative living hydrogel systems for the treatment of wound infections caused by antimicrobial-resistant (AMR) bacteria and biofilms. This project aims to create a new generation of injectable therapeutic hydrogels that combine beneficial probiotics and bacteriophages to simultaneously eradicate bacterial infections and promote tissue regeneration. With a strong translational focus, the project seeks to advance these living therapeutic systems toward clinically relevant solutions for wound infections and antimicrobial resistance.

 Your tasks

 You will contribute to the development of injectable, self-healing biomaterial-based hydrogels for the local delivery of probiotics and bacteriophages to wound sites. Your work will involve: 
• Design and synthesis of injectable hydrogel systems 

• Encapsulation and controlled delivery of probiotics and bacteriophages 

• Engineering and characterization of phage-based antimicrobial strategies against pathogenic bacteria and biofilms 

• Characterization and optimization of hydrogel properties and biological functionality 

• Evaluation of tissue regeneration and the therapeutic potential of living therapeutics 

• Elucidation of mechanisms of action and investigation of antimicrobial resistance evolution
 

 Your profile

 We are looking for a highly motivated and curious candidate with: 
• A Master's degree in Biomaterials, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Chemistry, or a related field 

• Strong interest in antimicrobial resistance, biomaterials, microbiology, or phage therapy 

• Experience in one or more of the following areas: Microbiology and bacterial culture / Biofilm research / Biomaterials and hydrogels / Molecular biology or synthetic biology / Bacteriophages 

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken 

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary team Previous experience with phages, hydrogels, wound healing models, or antimicrobial testing is advantageous.
 

 Our offer

 
• A highly international and multidisciplinary research environment 

• Access to state-of-the-art research infrastructure 

• Scientific training spanning microbiology, biomaterials engineering, phage biology, and translational biomedical research 

• Close collaboration with leading bacteriophage experts at ETH Zurich and opportunities to work across disciplines 

• A stimulating work environment within one of Switzerland's leading research institutions 

• Attractive employment conditions according to Empa regulations The position is available from November 2026 or after negotiation with a duration of four years.
 

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

PhD Posizione in Batterie e Materiali Interazioni

Il Laboratorio Biointerfaces di Empa a St. Gallen offre una posizione di dottorato nel campo dei biomateriali antimicrobici, della microbiologia e della terapia batteriofage. Il candidato di successo si unirà a un team di ricerca interdisciplinare che sviluppa sistemi innovativi di idrogel vivente per il trattamento delle infezioni delle ferite causate da batteri e biofilm antimicrobici-resistente (AMR). Questo progetto mira a creare una nuova generazione di idrogeli terapeutici iniettabili che combinano probiotici benefici e batteriofagi per sradicare contemporaneamente le infezioni batteriche e promuovere la rigenerazione dei tessuti. Con un forte focus traduttivo, il progetto mira a far avanzare questi sistemi terapeutici viventi verso soluzioni clinicamente rilevanti per le infezioni delle ferite e la resistenza antimicrobica.

I tuoi compiti

Contribuirai allo sviluppo di idrogeli a base di biomateriali iniettabili per la consegna locale di probiotici e batteriofagi ai siti di ferita. Il vostro lavoro coinvolgerà:
• Progettazione e sintesi di impianti idrogel iniettabili

• Incapsulamento e distribuzione controllata di probiotici e batteriofagi

• Ingegneria e caratterizzazione delle strategie antimicrobiche basate sul phage contro batteri patogeni e biofilm

• Caratterizzazione e ottimizzazione delle proprietà idrogel e della funzionalità biologica

• Valutazione della rigenerazione dei tessuti e del potenziale terapeutico dei terapeutici viventi

• Eucidazione dei meccanismi di azione e di indagine dell'evoluzione della resistenza antimicrobica

Il tuo profilo

Stiamo cercando un candidato altamente motivato e curioso con:
• Laurea Magistrale in Biomateriali, Ingegneria Biomedicale, Biotecnologia, Microbiologia, Biologia Molecolare, Chimica, o un campo correlato

• Forte interesse per la resistenza antimicrobica, i biomateriali, la microbiologia o la terapia di phage

• Esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree: Microbiologia e cultura batterica / Biofilm ricerca / Biomaterials and hydrogels / Biologia molecolare o biologia sintetica / Bacteriophages

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, scritto e parlato

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo efficacemente a un team interdisciplinare Esperienza precedente con phage, idrogel, modelli di guarigione delle ferite, o test antimicrobico è vantaggioso.

La nostra offerta

• Un ambiente di ricerca altamente internazionale e multidisciplinare

• Accesso all'infrastruttura di ricerca all'avanguardia

• Formazione scientifica che spazia dalla microbiologia, ingegneria dei biomateriali, biologia della fogna e ricerca biomedica traduttiva

• Una stretta collaborazione con i principali esperti di batteriofage dell'ETH di Zurigo e le opportunità di lavorare attraverso le discipline

• Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante all'interno di uno dei principali istituti di ricerca della Svizzera

• Condizioni di lavoro attraenti secondo i regolamenti Empa La posizione è disponibile dal novembre 2026 o dopo la negoziazione con una durata di quattro anni.

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Materialwissenschaft und Technologie sind unsere Leidenschaft. Mit unserer Spitzenforschung leisten die rund 1.100 Mitarbeiter der Empa wesentliche Beiträge zum Wohl der Gesellschaft für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Die Empa ist eine Forschungseinrichtung des ETH-Bereichs.

PhD Position in Bakterien & Materialien Interaktionen

Das Biointerfaces Laboratory der Empa in St. Gallen bietet eine Doktorarbeit im Bereich antimikrobieller Biomaterialien, Mikrobiologie und Bakteriophagentherapie an. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird sich einem interdisziplinären Forschungsteam anschließen, das innovative lebende Hydrogelsysteme zur Behandlung von Wundinfektionen entwickelt, die durch antimikrobielle Resistenzen (AMR) und Biofilme verursacht werden. Dieses Projekt zielt darauf ab, eine neue Generation injizierbarer therapeutischer Hydrogele zu schaffen, die nützliche Probiotika und Bakteriophagen kombinieren, um gleichzeitig bakterielle Infektionen zu beseitigen und die Regeneration von Gewebe zu fördern. Mit einem starken translationalen Fokus will das Projekt diese lebenden therapeutischen Systeme hin zu klinisch relevanten Lösungen für Wundinfektionen und antimikrobielle Resistenzen voranbringen.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie werden zur Entwicklung von injizierbaren, selbstheilenden Biomaterial-basierten Hydrogelen für die lokale Abgabe von Probiotika und Bakteriophagen an Wundstellen beitragen. Ihre Arbeit umfasst:
• Design und Synthese von injizierbaren Hydrogelsystemen

• Verkapselung und kontrollierte Abgabe von Probiotika und Bakteriophagen

• Engineering und Charakterisierung von Phagen-basierten antimikrobiellen Strategien gegen pathogene Bakterien und Biofilme

• Charakterisierung und Optimierung von Hydrogeleigenschaften und biologischer Funktionalität

• Bewertung der Geweberegeneration und des therapeutischen Potenzials lebender Therapeutika

• Aufklärung der Wirkungsmechanismen und Untersuchung der Entwicklung der Antibiotikaresistenz

Dein Profil

Wir suchen einen hoch motivierten und neugierigen Kandidaten mit:
• Ein Master-Abschluss in Biomaterialien, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnologie, Mikrobiologie, Molekularbiologie, Chemie oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Starkes Interesse an antimikrobiellen Resistenzen, Biomaterialien, Mikrobiologie oder Phagentherapie

• Erfahrung in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Mikrobiologie und Bakterienkultur / Biofilmforschung / Biomaterialien und Hydrogele / Molekularbiologie oder synthetische Biologie / Bakteriophagen

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, sowohl geschrieben als auch gesprochen

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH.

Poste de doctorat en interactions bactéries et matériaux

Le Laboratoire de biointerfaces d'Empa à St. Gallen offre un poste de doctorat dans le domaine des biomatériaux antimicrobiens, de la microbiologie et de la bactériophage. Le candidat retenu se joindra à une équipe de recherche interdisciplinaire qui mettra au point des systèmes d'hydrogel vivants novateurs pour le traitement des infections causées par des bactéries et des biofilms résistants aux antimicrobiens. Ce projet vise à créer une nouvelle génération d'hydrogels thérapeutiques injectables qui combinent probiotiques bénéfiques et bactériophages pour éradiquer simultanément les infections bactériennes et favoriser la régénération des tissus. Fortement axé sur la traduction, le projet vise à faire progresser ces systèmes thérapeutiques vivants vers des solutions cliniquement pertinentes pour les infections des plaies et la résistance aux antimicrobiens.

Vos tâches

Vous contribuerez au développement d'hydrogels à base de biomatériaux injectables autoguérisables pour la livraison locale de probiotiques et de bactériophages aux sites de plaies. Votre travail consistera à :
• Conception et synthèse de systèmes hydrogel injectables

• Encapsulation et livraison contrôlée de probiotiques et de bactériophages

• Ingénierie et caractérisation des stratégies antimicrobiennes fondées sur le phage contre les bactéries pathogènes et les biofilms

• Caractérisation et optimisation des propriétés hydrogel et des fonctionnalités biologiques

• Évaluation de la régénération des tissus et du potentiel thérapeutique des thérapies vivantes

• Élucidation des mécanismes d'action et étude de l'évolution de la résistance aux antimicrobiens

Votre profil

Nous cherchons un candidat très motivé et curieux avec:
• Maîtrise en biomatériaux, génie biomédical, biotechnologie, microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie ou domaine connexe

• Intérêt marqué pour la résistance aux antimicrobiens, les biomatériaux, la microbiologie ou la phagethérapie

• Expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : Microbiologie et culture bactérienne / Recherche biofilm / Biomatériaux et hydrogels / Biologie moléculaire ou biologie synthétique / Bactériophages

• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée

• Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant efficacement à une équipe interdisciplinaire L'expérience antérieure avec les phages, les hydrogels, les modèles de guérison des plaies ou les tests antimicrobiens est avantageuse.

Notre offre

• Un environnement de recherche hautement international et multidisciplinaire

• Accès à une infrastructure de recherche de pointe

• Formation scientifique couvrant la microbiologie, l'ingénierie des biomatériaux, la biologie des phages et la recherche biomédicale translationnelle

• Collaboration étroite avec des experts en bactériophage de premier plan à l'ETH Zurich et possibilités de travailler dans toutes les disciplines

• Un environnement de travail stimulant au sein d'un des plus grands instituts de recherche de Suisse

• Conditions d'emploi attrayantes selon la réglementation Empa Le poste est disponible à partir de novembre 2026 ou après négociation avec une durée de quatre ans.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 PhD position in vibrational and optoelectronic properties of quasi-1D chalcogenides

 The Nanomaterials Spectroscopy and Imaging Group within Empa's Transport at Nanoscale Interfaces Laboratory develops and applies advanced optical and time-resolved spectroscopic methods to understand how structure, defects and the local environment govern material behaviour. We are looking for a PhD student to investigate quasi-1D (Ba,Sr)(Ti,Nb,Ta)(S,Se)3 chalcogenides, a family of semiconductors with strong optical anisotropy and collective electronic phenomena such as charge-density-wave order. The project will establish how composition, defects and chain alignment determine vibrational, optical and carrier-dynamic properties in single crystals and orientation-controlled thin films. The PhD is part of a collaborative project with FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg funded by SNF and DPG.

 Your tasks

 
• Perform Raman and photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy, including polarization- and temperature-dependent measurements, to investigate structural, vibrational and optoelectronic properties of quasi-1D chalcogenides. 

• Characterize optical properties and carrier dynamics using time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL), terahertz spectroscopy and transient absorption. 

• Develop and apply data-analysis approaches for correlating results obtained from complementary characterization techniques. 

• Collaborate closely with synthesis, theory and device partners, and publish and present the results in peer-reviewed journals and at international conferences.
 

 Your profile

 
• Master's degree in physics, materials science, chemistry, nanoscience or a closely related field. 

• Strong interest in optical spectroscopy, semiconductor physics and low-dimensional or quantum materials. 

• A plus is hands-on experience with Raman, photoluminescence, time-resolved spectroscopy, cryogenic measurements or semiconductor characterization is an advantage. 

• Experience with quantitative data analysis and programming (e.g. Python or MATLAB) is an asset. 

• A self-motivated and organized working style, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary and international team. 

• Excellent written and spoken English; willingness to collaborate across institutions and undertake a research stay abroad.
 

 Our offer

 We offer a fully funded, full-time (100%) PhD position for three years at Empa in Dübendorf, near Zurich, with a starting date on 1st of March. You will work in a highly interdisciplinary environment with access to state-of-the-art materials-characterization infrastructure. We provide excellent research conditions within the ETH Domain and strong opportunities for scientific training, conference participation and career development. The PhD will be enrolled at University of Basel.

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

Posizione del dottorato in proprietà vibrazionali e optoelettroniche di chalcogenides quasi-1D

Il Nanomaterials Spectroscopy and Imaging Group all'interno di Empa's Transport presso Nanoscale Interfaces Laboratory si sviluppa e applica metodi spettroscopici avanzati e risolti nel tempo per capire come struttura, difetti e ambiente locale governano il comportamento materiale. Stiamo cercando uno studente di dottorato per indagare quasi-1D (Ba,Sr)(Ti,Nb,Ta)(S,Se)3 chalcogenides, una famiglia di semiconduttori con forte anisotropia ottica e fenomeni elettronici collettivi come l'ordine di carica-density-wave. Il progetto stabilirà come la composizione, i difetti e l'allineamento della catena determinano le proprietà vibrazionali, ottiche e carrier-dinamiche nei singoli cristalli e nei film sottili orientati. Il PhD fa parte di un progetto collaborativo con FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg finanziato da SNF e DPG.

I tuoi compiti

• Eseguire la spettroscopia Raman e fotoluminescenza (PL), comprese le misurazioni polarizzazione- e dipendente dalla temperatura, per indagare le proprietà strutturali, vibrazionali e optoelettroniche di quasi 1D chalcogenides.

• Caratterizzare le proprietà ottiche e le dinamiche portanti utilizzando la fotoluminescenza risolta nel tempo (TRPL), la spettroscopia di terahertz e l'assorbimento transitorio.

• Sviluppare e applicare approcci di analisi dei dati per la correlazione dei risultati ottenuti da tecniche di caratterizzazione complementare.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i partner di sintesi, teoria e dispositivi, e pubblicare e presentare i risultati in riviste peer-reviewed e a conferenze internazionali.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in fisica, scienza dei materiali, chimica, nanoscienza o un campo strettamente correlato.

• Forte interesse per la spettroscopia ottica, la fisica dei semiconduttori e i materiali di bassa dimensione o quantistica.

• Un plus è esperienza pratica con Raman, fotoluminescenza, spettroscopia risolta nel tempo, misurazioni criogeniche o caratterizzazione semiconduttore è un vantaggio.

• L'esperienza con l'analisi quantitativa dei dati e la programmazione (ad esempio Python o MATLAB) è un bene.

• Uno stile di lavoro auto-motivato e organizzato, con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, contribuendo efficacemente a un team interdisciplinare e internazionale.

• Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato; disponibilità a collaborare tra le istituzioni e intraprendere un soggiorno di ricerca all'estero.

La nostra offerta

Offriamo una posizione di dottorato a tempo pieno, a tempo pieno (100%) per tre anni a Empa a Dübendorf, vicino a Zurigo, con una data di inizio il 1 marzo. Potrai lavorare in un ambiente altamente interdisciplinare con l'accesso all'infrastruttura di caratterizzazione dei materiali all'avanguardia. Forniamo eccellenti condizioni di ricerca all'interno del dominio ETH e forti opportunità per la formazione scientifica, la partecipazione di conferenze e lo sviluppo di carriera. Il dottorato sarà iscritto all'Università di Basilea.

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le applicazioni via e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

Die Nanomaterials Spectroscopy and Imaging Group der Empa Transport at Nanoscale Interfaces Laboratory entwickelt und wendet fortschrittliche optische und zeitaufgelöste spektroskopische Methoden an, um zu verstehen, wie Struktur, Defekte und die lokale Umgebung das Materialverhalten steuern. Wir suchen einen Doktoranden, der Quasi-1D (Ba,Sr)(Ti,Nb,Ta)(S,Se)3 Chalkogenide untersucht, eine Familie von Halbleitern mit starker optischer Anisotropie und kollektiven elektronischen Phänomenen wie Ladungsdichte-Wellenordnung. Das Projekt wird ermitteln, wie Zusammensetzung, Defekte und Kettenausrichtung schwingende, optische und trägerdynamische Eigenschaften in Einkristallen und orientierungsgesteuerten Dünnfilmen bestimmen. Die Promotion ist Teil eines von SNF und DPG geförderten Verbundprojekts mit der FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Durchführung von Raman- und Photolumineszenzspektroskopie (PL), einschließlich polarisations- und temperaturabhängiger Messungen, zur Untersuchung der strukturellen, schwingenden und optoelektronischen Eigenschaften von Quasi-1D-Chalkogeniden.

• Charakterisieren Sie optische Eigenschaften und Trägerdynamik mit zeitaufgelöster Photolumineszenz (TRPL), Terahertz-Spektroskopie und transienter Absorption.

• Entwicklung und Anwendung von Datenanalyseansätzen zur Korrelation von Ergebnissen aus komplementären Charakterisierungstechniken.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Synthese-, Theorie- und Gerätepartnern zusammen und veröffentlichen und präsentieren Sie die Ergebnisse in Fachzeitschriften und auf internationalen Konferenzen.

Dein Profil

• Master-Abschluss in Physik, Materialwissenschaften, Chemie, Nanowissenschaften oder einem eng verwandten Bereich.

• Starkes Interesse an optischer Spektroskopie, Halbleiterphysik und niederdimensionalen oder Quantenmaterialien.

• Ein Plus ist praktische Erfahrung mit Raman, Photolumineszenz, zeitaufgelöste Spektroskopie, kryogene Messungen oder Halbleitercharakterisierung ist von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung mit quantitativer Datenanalyse und Programmierung (z. B. Python oder MATLAB) ist eine Bereicherung.

• Ein selbstmotivierter und organisierter Arbeitsstil mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig effektiv zu einem interdisziplinären und internationalen Team beizutragen.

• Hervorragendes geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch; Bereitschaft, über Institutionen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten und einen Forschungsaufenthalt im Ausland zu unternehmen.

Unser Angebot

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH.

Position du doctorat dans les propriétés vibrationnelles et optoélectroniques des chalcogénides quasi-1D

Le groupe de spectroscopie et d'imagerie des nanomatériaux du Laboratoire d'interfaces à l'échelle nanométrique d'Empa développe et applique des méthodes spectroscopies optiques et résolues dans le temps pour comprendre comment la structure, les défauts et l'environnement local régissent le comportement matériel. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un doctorant pour étudier les quasi-1D (Ba,Sr)(Ti,Nb,Ta)(S,Se)3 chalcogenides, une famille de semi-conducteurs à forte anisotropie optique et des phénomènes électroniques collectifs tels que l'ordre des ondes de densité de charge. Le projet déterminera comment la composition, les défauts et l'alignement de la chaîne déterminent les propriétés vibratoires, optiques et porteuses-dynamiques dans des cristaux simples et des films minces contrôlés par orientation. Le doctorat fait partie d'un projet de collaboration avec FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg financé par SNF et DPG.

Vos tâches

• Effectuer la spectroscopie Raman et la photoluminescence (PL), y compris des mesures dépendantes de la polarisation et de la température, pour étudier les propriétés structurales, vibratoires et optoélectroniques des chalcogénides quasi-1D.

• Caractériser les propriétés optiques et la dynamique du porteur en utilisant la photoluminescence résolue dans le temps (TRPL), la spectroscopie térahertz et l'absorption transitoire.

• Élaborer et appliquer des méthodes d'analyse des données pour corréler les résultats obtenus grâce aux techniques de caractérisation complémentaires.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires de la synthèse, de la théorie et du dispositif, et publier et présenter les résultats dans des revues évaluées par les pairs et lors de conférences internationales.

Votre profil

• Maîtrise en physique, sciences des matériaux, chimie, nanoscience ou domaine étroitement lié.

• Un vif intérêt pour la spectroscopie optique, la physique des semi-conducteurs et les matériaux de faible dimension ou quantique.

• Un plus est l'expérience pratique avec Raman, la photoluminescence, la spectroscopie résolue dans le temps, les mesures cryogéniques ou la caractérisation des semi-conducteurs est un avantage.

• L'expérience de l'analyse et de la programmation de données quantitatives (p. ex. Python ou MATLAB) est un atout.

• Un style de travail automotivé et organisé, capable de travailler de façon indépendante tout en contribuant efficacement à une équipe interdisciplinaire et internationale.

• Excellent anglais écrit et parlé; volonté de collaborer entre les établissements et d'entreprendre un séjour de recherche à l'étranger.

Notre offre

Nous offrons un poste de doctorat à temps plein et entièrement financé (100 %) pour trois ans à Empa à Dübendorf, près de Zurich, avec une date de début le 1er mars. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement hautement interdisciplinaire avec l'accès à des matériaux de pointe-caractérisation infrastructure. Nous offrons d'excellentes conditions de recherche dans le domaine de l'ETH et de fortes possibilités de formation scientifique, de participation à des conférences et de développement de carrière. Le doctorat sera inscrit à l'Université de Bâle.

Nous vivons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui s'intéressent à des activités novatrices, durables et significatives - c'est ce qui compte.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne complète comprenant une lettre de motivation, CV, certificats, diplômes et coordonnées de deux personnes de référence. Veuillez les soumettre exclusivement via notre portail d'emploi. Les demandes par courrier électronique et par la poste ne seront pas prises en considération.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 Postdoctoral Researcher in the Development of Thin Films and Deposition Processes using Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Experiments.

 The Coating Technologies Group in Empa's Laboratory for Surface Science & Coating Technologies develops next-generation functional thin films through innovative deposition processes and high-throughput materials screening. 
 The opportunity 
 Contribute to groundbreaking research on accelerated thin-film and process development for emerging applications such as ferroelectric memory, photonic integrated circuits and next-generation telecommunications. You'll work at the exciting intersection of experimental materials science and materials informatics, collaborating in an interdisciplinary team.

 Your tasks

 
• Conduct physical vapor deposition experiments using advanced PVD processes such as synchronized HiPIMS 

• Perform in-depth materials characterization and surface analysis 

• Apply and improve high-throughput experimental workflows including closed-loop thin-film optimization 

• Apply AI and Machine Learning for data analysis and modelling 

• Develop, improve and implement HW/SW concepts and components to automate experiments and enable autonomous experiments 
 
 The focus of this position is to use advanced PVD processes to develop state-of-the art thin films, such as piezoelectric and ferroelectric nitrides. You will use synchronized HiPIMS processes to tune the properties and performance of the films. The experiments will be informed by in-situ surface and interface analysis. 

 Your work will make use of our group's unique comprehensive infrastructure for materials and device characterization. In addition, the work will benefit from a unique self-driving thin-film laboratory. This laboratory is currently in development and will include sputter deposition and in-situ surface analysis techniques such as RHEED, AES and XPS. Part of the work is also to optimize the workflows in this laboratory in collaboration with the team.

 Your profile

 
• PhD degree in physics, materials science, chemistry, electrical engineering or a related discipline 

• Knowledge of UHV and thin-film technology 

• Prior experience in PVD and surface science 

• Prior experience with piezoelectric- or ferroelectric nitrides is an advantage 

• Knowledge of PVD process development and pulsed sputtering is an advantage 

• Proficiency in Python programming 

• Interest in lab-automation and working with agentic AI (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) 

• Excellent communication skills in English

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 Postdoctoral Researcher in Tabular Foundation Models for Building and District Energy Systems

 Our passion lies in materials science and technology, and at the Urban Energy Systems Laboratory (UESL), we develop strategies and methods to support the creation of decarbonized, resilient, and equitable energy systems. 

 This PostDoc position is offered in collaboration with the Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Laboratory at EPFL ( Prof. Olga Fink ). IMOS develops advanced machine-learning and AI methods for complex engineering and industrial systems, with a particular focus on improving their reliability, availability, and operational performance while enabling more efficient and cost-effective maintenance. 

 To advance the development of tabular foundation models for energy systems, we are seeking a highly motivated and skilled postdoctoral researcher. The project aims to develop foundation models that can learn from heterogeneous tabular data across buildings and district-scale energy systems and transfer across systems, operating conditions, and downstream tasks. The position combines Empa UESL’s expertise in developing and accessing energy system models with the methodological expertise of the IMOS Laboratory in machine learning and foundation models.

 Your tasks

 
• Evaluate and benchmark existing pre-trained tabular foundation models for building- and district-scale energy applications, assessing their transferability and generalization across systems, operating conditions, and downstream tasks. 

• Adapt and fine-tune existing foundation models for energy-system applications, investigating efficient adaptation strategies and the use of domain-specific data and knowledge. 

• Develop new tabular foundation-model approaches where existing pre-trained models are insufficient, with a particular focus on transferability across heterogeneous energy systems and datasets. 

• Validate and benchmark the developed models using building measurements , physics-based simulations and energy-system optimization models. 

• Investigate how tabular foundation models can support energy-system modelling and optimization , including applications such as prediction, surrogate modelling, uncertainty quantification, and decision support. 

• Coordinate the joint research activities between UESL and IMOS. 

• Publish and present research perspectives and results. 

• Contribute to research proposals and the acquisition of competitive funding.
 

 Your profile

 We seek a highly motivated and dedicated researcher with a PhD in mathematics, electrical or mechanical engineering, computer science or a related field, and a strong methodological background in machine learning. The ideal candidate has demonstrated research experience with foundation models , including the evaluation and adaptation of pre-trained models, fine-tuning strategies, and the development of new model architectures or learning approaches. Experience with tabular foundation models or foundation models for structured data is particularly relevant to this position. 
 Key qualifications include: 
 
• Strong research experience in deep learning and foundation models, including experience with pre-trained models, fine-tuning, transfer learning, or self-supervised learning. Experience with tabular foundation models or foundation models for structured data is particularly relevant. 

• A strong understanding of modern deep-learning architectures and training strategies, and experience designing and rigorously evaluating new machine-learning methods. • Excellent Python programming skills and strong hands-on experience implementing, training, and evaluating deep-learning models and research codebases. 

• A strong track record in machine learning or closely related fields 

• Excellent written and spoken English 
 Ideally, the candidate also: 
 
• Has experience in energy system modeling and optimization 

• Has experience with tabular or heterogeneous data, particularly across multiple da-tasets, domains, or tasks 

• Is familiar with mathematical optimization methods, such as mixed-integer linear programming 

• Has experience with uncertainty quantification, surrogate modelling or physics-informed machine learning 

• Has an understanding of the technical challenges associated with the energy transition
 

 Our offer

 
• A stimulating and interdisciplinary research environment and opportunities for personal and professional development 

• Close collaboration between Empa and EPFL, bringing together complementary expertise in energy systems, machine learning, and foundation models 

• The opportunity to shape an emerging research direction at the interface of artificial intelligence, energy-system modelling and optimization 

• The possibility of starting immediately or by agreement
 

 We foster a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, a one-page research proposal on how you'd tackle your tasks , certificates, diplomas, and contact details for two referees. The research proposal should briefly outline the candidate’s research vision and proposed methodological directions for advancing tabular foundation models for energy systems, including potential research questions and approaches relevant to the position. Please submit your application exclusively via our job portal. Applications sent via email or post will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Tabular Foundation Models for Building and District Energy Systems

Our passion lies in materials science and technology, and at the Urban Energy Systems Laboratory (UESL), we develop strategies and methods to support the creation of decarbonized, resilient, and equitable energy systems.

This PostDoc position is offered in collaboration with the Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Laboratory at EPFL ( Prof. Olga Fink ). IMOS develops advanced machine-learning and AI methods for complex engineering and industrial systems, with a particular focus on improving their reliability, availability, and operational performance while enabling more efficient and cost-effective maintenance.

To advance the development of tabular foundation models for energy systems, we are seeking a highly motivated and skilled postdoctoral researcher. The project aims to develop foundation models that can learn from heterogeneous tabular data across buildings and district-scale energy systems and transfer across systems, operating conditions, and downstream tasks. The position combines Empa UESL’s expertise in developing and accessing energy system models with the methodological expertise of the IMOS Laboratory in machine learning and foundation models.

Your tasks

• Evaluate and benchmark existing pre-trained tabular foundation models for building- and district-scale energy applications, assessing their transferability and generalization across systems, operating conditions, and downstream tasks.

• Adapt and fine-tune existing foundation models for energy-system applications, investigating efficient adaptation strategies and the use of domain-specific data and knowledge.

• Develop new tabular foundation-model approaches where existing pre-trained models are insufficient, with a particular focus on transferability across heterogeneous energy systems and datasets.

• Validate and benchmark the developed models using building measurements , physics-based simulations and energy-system optimization models.

• Investigate how tabular foundation models can support energy-system modelling and optimization , including applications such as prediction, surrogate modelling, uncertainty quantification, and decision support.

• Coordinate the joint research activities between UESL and IMOS.

• Publish and present research perspectives and results.

• Contribute to research proposals and the acquisition of competitive funding.

Your profile

We seek a highly motivated and dedicated researcher with a PhD in mathematics, electrical or mechanical engineering, computer science or a related field, and a strong methodological background in machine learning. The ideal candidate has demonstrated research experience with foundation models , including the evaluation and adaptation of pre-trained models, fine-tuning strategies, and the development of new model architectures or learning approaches. Experience with tabular foundation models or foundation models for structured data is particularly relevant to this position.
Key qualifications include:

• Strong research experience in deep learning and foundation models, including experience with pre-trained models, fine-tuning, transfer learning, or self-supervised learning. Experience with tabular foundation models or foundation models for structured data is particularly relevant.

• A strong understanding of modern deep-learning architectures and training strategies, and experience designing and rigorously evaluating new machine-learning methods. • Excellent Python programming skills and strong hands-on experience implementing, training, and evaluating deep-learning models and research codebases.

• A strong track record in machine learning or closely related fields

• Excellent written and spoken English
Ideally, the candidate also:

• Has experience in energy system modeling and optimization

• Has experience with tabular or heterogeneous data, particularly across multiple da-tasets, domains, or tasks

• Is familiar with mathematical optimization methods, such as mixed-integer linear programming

• Has experience with uncertainty quantification, surrogate modelling or physics-informed machine learning

• Has an understanding of the technical challenges associated with the energy transition

Our offer

• A stimulating and interdisciplinary research environment and opportunities for personal and professional development

• Close collaboration between Empa and EPFL, bringing together complementary expertise in energy systems, machine learning, and foundation models

• The opportunity to shape an emerging research direction at the interface of artificial intelligence, energy-system modelling and optimization

• The possibility of starting immediately or by agreement

We foster a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, a one-page research proposal on how you'd tackle your tasks , certificates, diplomas, and contact details for two referees. The research proposal should briefly outline the candidate’s research vision and proposed methodological directions for advancing tabular foundation models for energy systems, including potential research questions and approaches relevant to the position. Please submit your application exclusively via our job portal. Applications sent via email or post will not be considered.

Postdoktorand in tabellarischen Grundlagenmodellen für Gebäude- und Fernenergiesysteme

Unsere Leidenschaft liegt in der Materialwissenschaft und -technologie, und im Urban Energy Systems Laboratory (UESL) entwickeln wir Strategien und Methoden, um die Schaffung dekarbonisierter, widerstandsfähiger und gerechter Energiesysteme zu unterstützen.

Diese PostDoc-Stelle wird in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Labor Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) der EPFL (Prof. Olga Fink) angeboten. IMOS entwickelt fortschrittliche Machine-Learning- und KI-Methoden für komplexe Engineering- und Industriesysteme mit besonderem Fokus auf der Verbesserung ihrer Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit und Betriebsleistung bei gleichzeitig effizienterer und kostengünstigerer Wartung.

Um die Entwicklung tabellarischer Grundlagenmodelle für Energiesysteme voranzutreiben, suchen wir einen hochmotivierten und qualifizierten Postdoktoranden. Das Projekt zielt darauf ab, Grundlagenmodelle zu entwickeln, die aus heterogenen tabellarischen Daten über Gebäude und Energiesysteme auf Distriktebene lernen und über Systeme, Betriebsbedingungen und nachgelagerte Aufgaben übertragen können. Die Position verbindet die Expertise der Empa UESL bei der Entwicklung und dem Zugriff auf Energiesystemmodelle mit der methodischen Expertise des IMOS Labors für maschinelles Lernen und Grundlagenmodelle.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Bewerten und vergleichen Sie bestehende vortrainierte tabellarische Grundlagenmodelle für gebäude- und bezirksgroße Energieanwendungen und bewerten Sie deren Übertragbarkeit und Verallgemeinerung über Systeme, Betriebsbedingungen und nachgelagerte Aufgaben hinweg.

• Anpassung und Feinabstimmung bestehender Grundlagenmodelle für Energiesystemanwendungen, Untersuchung effizienter Anpassungsstrategien und Verwendung domänenspezifischer Daten und Wissen.

• Entwicklung neuer tabellarischer Grundlagenmodellansätze, bei denen die vorhandenen vortrainierten Modelle unzureichend sind, mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf der Übertragbarkeit über heterogene Energiesysteme und Datensätze hinweg.

• Validieren und vergleichen Sie die entwickelten Modelle unter Verwendung von Gebäudemessungen, physikbasierten Simulationen und Energiesystemoptimierungsmodellen.

• Untersuchen Sie, wie tabellarische Grundlagenmodelle die Energiesystemmodellierung und -optimierung unterstützen können, einschließlich Anwendungen wie Vorhersage, Ersatzmodellierung, Unsicherheitsquantifizierung und Entscheidungsunterstützung.

• Koordinieren Sie die gemeinsamen Forschungsaktivitäten zwischen UESL und IMOS.

• Veröffentlichen und präsentieren Sie Forschungsperspektiven und Ergebnisse.

Der ideale Kandidat hat Forschungserfahrung mit Grundlagenmodellen nachgewiesen, einschließlich der Bewertung und Anpassung vortrainierter Modelle, Feinabstimmungsstrategien und der Entwicklung neuer Modellarchitekturen oder Lernansätze. Erfahrungen mit tabellarischen Fundamentmodellen oder Fundamentmodellen für strukturierte Daten sind für diese Position besonders relevant.
Zu den wichtigsten Qualifikationen gehören:

• Starke Forschungserfahrung in Deep Learning und Grundlagenmodellen, einschließlich Erfahrung mit vortrainierten Modellen, Feinabstimmung, Transferlernen oder selbstüberwachtem Lernen. Erfahrungen mit tabellarischen Fundamentmodellen oder Fundamentmodellen für strukturierte Daten sind besonders relevant.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis moderner Deep-Learning-Architekturen und Trainingsstrategien sowie Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und rigorosen Bewertung neuer Machine-Learning-Methoden.
• Ausgezeichnete Python-Programmierfähigkeiten und eine gute praktische Erfahrung bei der Implementierung, Schulung und Bewertung von Deep-Learning-Modellen und Forschungs-Codebasen.

• Eine starke Erfolgsbilanz in maschinellem Lernen oder eng verwandten Bereichen

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch
Idealerweise ist der Kandidat auch:

• Hat Erfahrung in der Energiesystemmodellierung und -optimierung

• Hat Erfahrung mit tabellarischen oder heterogenen Daten, insbesondere über mehrere Da-Tasets, Domänen oder Aufgaben hinweg

• Ist vertraut mit mathematischen Optimierungsmethoden, wie z.B. Mixed-Integer lineare Programmierung

• Hat Erfahrung mit Unsicherheitsquantifizierung, Ersatzmodellierung oder Physik-informiertem maschinellem Lernen

• Hat ein Verständnis für die technischen Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit der Energiewende

Unser Angebot

• Enge Zusammenarbeit zwischen Empa und EPFL, die komplementäre Expertise in Energiesystemen, maschinellem Lernen und Grundlagenmodellen zusammenführt

descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH.

Chercheur postdoctoral dans les modèles de fondation tabulaires pour les systèmes énergétiques de construction et de district

Notre passion réside dans la science et la technologie des matériaux, et au Laboratoire des systèmes d'énergie urbaine (UESL), nous développons des stratégies et des méthodes pour soutenir la création de systèmes énergétiques décarbonés, résilients et équitables.

Ce poste PostDoc est proposé en collaboration avec le Laboratoire des Systèmes Intelligents de Maintenance et d'Exploitation (IMOS) de l'EPFL ( Prof. Olga Fink ). IMOS développe des méthodes avancées d'apprentissage automatique et d'intelligence artificielle pour des systèmes complexes d'ingénierie et d'industrie, en mettant l'accent sur l'amélioration de leur fiabilité, de leur disponibilité et de leur performance opérationnelle tout en permettant une maintenance plus efficace et rentable.

Pour faire progresser l'élaboration de modèles de base tabulaires pour les systèmes énergétiques, nous recherchons un chercheur postdoctoral hautement motivé et qualifié. Le projet vise à mettre au point des modèles de base qui peuvent s'inspirer de données tabulaires hétérogènes à l'échelle des bâtiments et des systèmes énergétiques à l'échelle du district, ainsi que des transferts entre les systèmes, les conditions d'exploitation et les tâches en aval. Le poste combine l'expertise d'Empa UESL de développer et d'accéder à des modèles de systèmes énergétiques avec l'expertise méthodologique du laboratoire IMOS dans l'apprentissage des machines et les modèles de fondation.

Vos tâches

• Évaluer et comparer les modèles de base tabulaires déjà formés pour les applications énergétiques à l'échelle des bâtiments et des districts, en évaluant leur transférabilité et leur généralisation entre les systèmes, les conditions d'exploitation et les tâches en aval.

• Adapter et affiner les modèles de base existants pour les applications des systèmes énergétiques, étudier des stratégies d'adaptation efficaces et l'utilisation de données et de connaissances spécifiques à un domaine.

• Élaborer de nouvelles approches tabulaires pour les modèles de base où les modèles préformés existants sont insuffisants, en mettant l'accent sur la transférabilité entre les systèmes et ensembles de données énergétiques hétérogènes.

• Valider et comparer les modèles développés en utilisant des mesures de bâtiment, des simulations basées sur la physique et des modèles d'optimisation du système énergétique.

• Étudier comment les modèles de base tabulaires peuvent soutenir la modélisation et l'optimisation des systèmes énergétiques, y compris des applications telles que la prédiction, la modélisation de substitution, la quantification de l'incertitude et l'aide à la décision.

• Coordonner les activités de recherche conjointes entre l'UESL et l'IMOS.

• Publier et présenter les perspectives et les résultats de la recherche.

• Contribuer aux propositions de recherche et à l'acquisition d'un financement concurrentiel.

Votre profil

Nous recherchons un chercheur hautement motivé et dévoué avec un doctorat en mathématiques, en génie électrique ou mécanique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, et une solide formation méthodologique en apprentissage automatique. Le candidat idéal a démontré son expérience de recherche avec les modèles de fondation, y compris l'évaluation et l'adaptation des modèles pré-formés, les stratégies de réglage fin, et le développement de nouvelles architectures de modèles ou approches d'apprentissage. L'expérience des modèles de base tabulaires ou des modèles de base pour les données structurées est particulièrement pertinente à cette position.
Les principales qualifications sont les suivantes :

• Forte expérience de recherche dans les modèles d'apprentissage profond et de fondation, y compris l'expérience des modèles pré-formés, le réglage fin, l'apprentissage par transfert ou l'apprentissage auto-supervisé. L'expérience des modèles de base tabulaires ou des modèles de base pour les données structurées est particulièrement pertinente.

• Une bonne compréhension des architectures modernes d'apprentissage en profondeur et des stratégies de formation, ainsi qu'une expérience de conception et d'évaluation rigoureuse des nouvelles méthodes d'apprentissage en machine.
• Excellentes compétences en programmation Python et une solide expérience pratique mise en œuvre, formation et évaluation des modèles d'apprentissage profond et des bases de données de recherche.

• Une solide expérience en apprentissage automatique ou dans des domaines étroitement liés

• Excellent anglais écrit et parlé
Idéalement, le candidat :

• A de l'expérience dans la modélisation et l'optimisation du système énergétique

• A de l'expérience avec des données tabulaires ou hétérogènes, en particulier sur plusieurs da-tasets, domaines ou tâches

• Est familier avec les méthodes d'optimisation mathématique, comme la programmation linéaire en entier mixte

• A l'expérience de la quantification de l'incertitude, de la modélisation de substitution ou de l'apprentissage automatique éclairé par la physique

• Compréhension des défis techniques liés à la transition énergétique

Notre offre

• Un environnement de recherche stimulant et interdisciplinaire et des possibilités de développement personnel et professionnel

• Une collaboration étroite entre Empa et l'EPFL, réunissant une expertise complémentaire dans les systèmes énergétiques, l'apprentissage automatique et les modèles de fondation

• L'occasion de façonner une nouvelle orientation de la recherche à l'interface de l'intelligence artificielle, de la modélisation du système énergétique et de l'optimisation

• La possibilité de commencer immédiatement ou par accord

Nous favorisons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui s'intéressent à des activités novatrices, durables et significatives - c'est ce qui compte.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne complète, y compris une lettre de motivation, CV, une proposition de recherche d'une page sur la façon dont vous aborderez vos tâches, certificats, diplômes, et les coordonnées de deux arbitres. La proposition de recherche devrait décrire brièvement la vision de recherche du candidat et les orientations méthodologiques proposées pour faire avancer les modèles de base tabulaires pour les systèmes énergétiques, y compris les questions de recherche et les approches pertinentes au poste. jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 PhD position: Multi-scale Modelling and Experimental Assessment of Volumetrically Prestressed Concrete

 Smart and Sustainable Resilient Performance-based Cementitious Composites for Adaptive Strengthening and Repair System (SURPASS) is an EU Horizon Research and Innovation project (2027-2031) which aims to develop adaptive strengthening and repair strategies for ageing infrastructure in aggressive environments. The project endeavours to develop intervention procedures that can help reduce maintenance costs and increase circularity over the life cycle of a structure. The SURPASS solutions combine eco-efficient UHPFRC containing CO2-negative SCMs, bio-based self-healing, hybrid fiber architecture, Fe-SMA-based self-prestressing, and integrated structural health monitoring into one coherent system for thin, durable structural interventions. It can be deployed through conventional casting for standard applications and through 3D printing for complex or non-planar geometries. In parallel, circular end-of-life strategies will recover fibres, upcycle fines into new low-carbon constituents, and enable structural reuse. The project comprises 11 partners across the globe, including partners from Europe, Canada and Japan

 Your tasks

 The tasks of the PhD at ETHZ and Empa within the framework of SURPASS are as follows: 
 
• Volumetric prestressing of cast and 3D-printable SURPASS overlays using Fe-SMA fibres. 

• Meso-scale finite element modelling of volumetric prestressing mechanisms with Fe-SMA fibres, including activation, recovery stress, prestress transfer, and reactivation. 

• Structural-scale simulation of SURPASS overlays in strengthened members, including parametric finite element analyses for surrogate-model development and digital-twin support. 

• Large-scale experimental assessment of volumetrically prestressed SURPASS overlays for non-planar structures, including representative applications such as tunnel linings, arch intrados, and curved bridge soffits.
 

 Your profile

 The candidate should have a Master's degree in Structural Engineering (or related engineering) with a strong back-ground in nonlinear finite element modeling, structural mechanics, and concrete structures. Experience or interest in 3D concrete printing is also important. Additional skills, including experience in small and large-scale experimental investigations and knowledge of shape memory alloys, would be an advantage. A strong desire and motivation to find cutting-edge and innovative solutions in the field of structural engineering are essential. Excellent knowledge of English (oral and written) is mandatory. Knowledge of German would be an advantage.

 Our offer

 We offer a multifaceted, challenging, and fully funded Ph.D. position for 48 months in a modern research environment with excellent infrastructure supported by regular supervision. The thesis director of the PhD student will be Prof. Dr. Eleni Chatzi, who heads the Chair of Structural Mechanics and Monitoring at ETH Zurich. The candidate will be based at Empa Dübendorf, where the day-to-day research will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Moslem Shahverdi and Dr. Saim Raza. The position is available as soon as possible but should be filled by no later than 1 March 2027.

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

Posizione del dottorato: Modellazione multiscala e valutazione sperimentale del calcestruzzo prestressato volumetrica

Smart and Sustainable Resilient Performance-based Cementitious Composites for Adaptive Strengthening and Repair System (SURPASS) è un progetto UE Horizon Research and Innovation (2027-2031) che mira a sviluppare strategie di rafforzamento e riparazione adattative per l'invecchiamento delle infrastrutture in ambienti aggressivi. Il progetto si sforza di sviluppare procedure di intervento che possono contribuire a ridurre i costi di manutenzione e aumentare la circolarità nel ciclo di vita di una struttura. Le soluzioni SURPASS combinano UHPFRC eco-efficiente contenente SCM CO2-negativi, auto-guarigione a base bio, architettura ibrida in fibra, auto-prestressing basato su Fe-SMA e monitoraggio strutturale integrato in un sistema coerente per interventi strutturali sottili e durevoli. Può essere utilizzato tramite colata convenzionale per applicazioni standard e tramite stampa 3D per geometrie complesse o non piane. Parallelamente, le strategie circolari di fine vita riprenderanno le fibre, le ammende di upcycle in nuovi costituenti a basso tenore di carbonio e consentiranno il riutilizzo strutturale. Il progetto comprende 11 partner in tutto il mondo, tra cui partner provenienti da Europa, Canada e Giappone

I tuoi compiti

I compiti del dottorato in ETHZ e Empa nel quadro di SURPASS sono i seguenti:

• Prestress volumetrico di sovrapposizioni SURPASS stampate in 3D utilizzando fibre Fe-SMA.

• Modellazione di elementi finiti su scala Meso di meccanismi di prestressing volumetrico con fibre Fe-SMA, tra cui attivazione, stress di recupero, trasferimento prestress e riattivazione.

• Simulazione su scala strutturale dei sovrapposizioni SURPASS nei membri rafforzati, comprese le analisi degli elementi finiti parametrici per lo sviluppo del modello surrogato e il supporto digitale-twin.

• Valutazione sperimentale su larga scala di sovrapposizioni SURPASS volumetricamente prestressate per strutture nonplane, comprese applicazioni rappresentative come i rivestimenti del tunnel, l'arco intrados, e soffitti del ponte curvo.

Il tuo profilo

Il candidato deve avere una laurea magistrale in ingegneria strutturale (o ingegneria correlata) con uno sfondo forte nella modellazione di elementi finiti non lineari, meccanica strutturale e strutture concrete. L'esperienza o l'interesse per la stampa in calcestruzzo 3D è anche importante. Ulteriori competenze, tra cui l'esperienza in piccole e grandi indagini sperimentali e la conoscenza delle leghe di memoria forma, sarebbero un vantaggio. Un forte desiderio e motivazione per trovare soluzioni all'avanguardia e innovative nel campo dell'ingegneria strutturale sono essenziali. Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese (orale e scritto) è obbligatoria. La conoscenza del tedesco sarebbe un vantaggio.

La nostra offerta

Offriamo una posizione Ph.D. multifacciata, impegnativa e completamente finanziata per 48 mesi in un ambiente di ricerca moderno con eccellenti infrastrutture supportate da una supervisione regolare. Il direttore di tesi dello studente di dottorato sarà Prof. Dr. Eleni Chatzi, che guida la Cattedra di Meccanica strutturale e Monitoraggio presso l'ETH di Zurigo. Il candidato si baserà presso Empa Dübendorf, dove la ricerca quotidiana sarà supervisionata dal Prof. Il dottor Moslem Shahverdi e il dottor Saim Raza. La posizione è disponibile il prima possibile, ma deve essere riempita entro il 1o marzo 2027.

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

The SURPASS solutions combine eco-efficient UHPFRC containing CO2-negative SCMs, bio-based self-healing, hybrid fiber architecture, Fe-SMA-based self-prestressing, and integrated structural health monitoring into one coherent system for thin, durable structural interventions. It can be deployed through conventional casting for standard applications and through 3D printing for complex or non-planar geometries. In parallel, circular end-of-life strategies will recover fibres, upcycle fines into new low-carbon constituents, and enable structural reuse. The project comprises 11 partners across the globe, including partners from Europe, Canada and Japan

Your tasks

The tasks of the PhD at ETHZ and Empa within the framework of SURPASS are as follows:

• Volumetric prestressing of cast and 3D-printable SURPASS overlays using Fe-SMA fibres.

• Meso-scale finite element modelling of volumetric prestressing mechanisms with Fe-SMA fibres, including activation, recovery stress, prestress transfer, and reactivation.

• Structural-scale simulation of SURPASS overlays in strengthened members, including parametric finite element analyses for surrogate-model development and digital-twin support.

• Large-scale experimental assessment of volumetrically prestressed SURPASS overlays for non-planar structures, including representative applications such as tunnel linings, arch intrados, and curved bridge soffits.

Your profile

The candidate should have a Master's degree in Structural Engineering (or related engineering) with a strong back-ground in nonlinear finite element modeling, structural mechanics, and concrete structures. Experience or interest in 3D concrete printing is also important. Additional skills, including experience in small and large-scale experimental investigations and knowledge of shape memory alloys, would be an advantage. A strong desire and motivation to find cutting-edge and innovative solutions in the field of structural engineering are essential. Excellent knowledge of English (oral and written) is mandatory. Knowledge of German would be an advantage.

Our offer

We offer a multifaceted, challenging, and fully funded Ph.D. position for 48 months in a modern research environment with excellent infrastructure supported by regular supervision. The thesis director of the PhD student will be Prof. Dr. Eleni Chatzi, who heads the Chair of Structural Mechanics and Monitoring at ETH Zurich. The candidate will be based at Empa Dübendorf, where the day-to-day research will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Moslem Shahverdi and Dr. Saim Raza. The position is available as soon as possible but should be filled by no later than 1 March 2027.

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Poste de doctorat: Modélisation à plusieurs échelles et évaluation expérimentale du béton précontraint volumétrique

Smart and Sustainable Resilient Performance-based Composites Cementious for Adaptive Strength and Repair System (SURPASS) est un projet européen de recherche et d'innovation Horizon (2027-2031) qui vise à développer des stratégies de renforcement et de réparation adaptatives pour les infrastructures vieillissantes dans des environnements agressifs. Le projet s'efforce d'élaborer des procédures d'intervention qui peuvent contribuer à réduire les coûts d'entretien et à accroître la circonspection sur le cycle de vie d'une structure. • Précontrainte volumétrique des superpositions SURPASS moulées et imprimées en 3D à l'aide de fibres Fe-SMA.

• Simulation à l'échelle structurale de superpositions de SUPRASS dans des membres renforcés, y compris des analyses parametric finies pour le développement de modèles substituts et le support numérique-twin.

• Évaluation expérimentale à grande échelle des recouvrements SUPRASS précontraints volumétriques pour les structures non planes, y compris des applications représentatives telles que les revêtements de tunnel, les intrados arches et les soffits de pont incurvés.

Votre profil

Le candidat devrait avoir une maîtrise en génie structurel (ou en génie connexe) avec un solide back-ground dans la modélisation non linéaire d'éléments finis, la mécanique structurelle et les structures en béton. L'expérience ou l'intérêt pour l'impression en béton 3D est également important. D'autres compétences, y compris l'expérience dans les recherches expérimentales à petite et grande échelle et la connaissance des alliages de mémoire de forme, seraient un avantage. Une volonté et une motivation fortes pour trouver des solutions innovantes et de pointe dans le domaine de l'ingénierie structurelle sont essentielles. jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 PhD position in the development of life-like materials that learn, remember, and forget for use in soft robotics

 In our research group, we design mechanically robust, multi-responsive polyurethane elastomer with backbone-integrated molecular switches. Our aim is to move beyond conventional stimuli-responsive materials, which merely switch between predetermined states, toward life-like materials that genuinely learn: Forming memories, consolidating them over time, selectively forgetting, and adapting their behavior through experience, all while retaining commercial-grade mechanical properties. 
 In this PhD project, you will synthesize and characterize semi-crystalline polyurethane elastomers containing backbone-integrated photo-, halo-, and thermochromic molecular switches, and investigate how their interactions can be engineered to produce quantifiable memory and learning behaviors.

 Your tasks

 
• Synthesize libraries of single-, dual-, and triple-switch polyurethanes (Stenhouse salt, DASA, and Spiropyran) via copolymerization and post-polymerization functionalization, and validate backbone integration by NMR, GPC, DSC, DMA, tensile testing, UV-Vis spectroscopy, and pump probe characterization. 

• Design and characterize synergistic switching cascades (collaborative, competitive, and interdependent pathways) using time-resolved and spatially resolved spectroscopy, patterned illumination, and pH/thermal stimuli. 

• Develop and validate logic maps for memory formation, consolidation, and selective forgetting, and translate these into training-recall-forgetting cycles on physical polymer films and bilayer actuators. 

• Contribute to integrating learning materials into soft robotic bilayer actuators and, together with the wider team, demonstrate behavioral adaptation in autonomous soft robots. 

• Collaborate with international partners
 

 Your profile

 The candidate should have a strong background in Organic Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Materials Science, or a closely related field. We are looking for a highly motivated, curious person who enjoys working at the interface of synthetic chemistry, materials science, and soft robotics, who is comfortable in a multidisciplinary, collaborative environment. The PhD candidate needs to be highly proficient in spoken and written English and hold a Master's degree. S/he will participate in writing scientific publications and presenting data at national and international scientific conferences. Previous experience in one or more of the following areas is required: 
• Polymer/polyurethane synthesis and characterization 

• Molecular switches (e.g., photochromic, halochromic, or thermochromic systems) 

• Standard analytical methods (NMR, UV-Vis, FTIR, and related techniques) 

• Thermomechanical characterization of polymers (DSC, DMA, tensile testing) Experience with soft actuators or soft robotic systems is a plus but not required.
 

 Our offer

 This project is part of an SNSF Ambizione grant led by Dr. Livius F. Muff, hosted in the group of Dr. Luciano Boesel at Empa. The work will primarily be carried out at Empa St.Gallen under the direct supervision of Dr. Livius F. Muff. The PhD student will be affiliated at ETH Zürich (Prof. René Rossi, D-HEST).

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

Posizione di dottorato nello sviluppo di materiali simili alla vita che imparano, ricordano e dimenticano per l'uso in robotica morbida

Nel nostro gruppo di ricerca, progettiamo elastomero poliuretanico a risposta multipla meccanicamente robusto con interruttori molecolari integrati a spina dorsale. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di andare oltre i materiali tradizionali di risposta agli stimoli, che si limitano a passare tra stati predeterminati, verso materiali realistici che imparano: formare ricordi, consolidarli nel tempo, dimenticarli selettivamente e adattare il loro comportamento attraverso l'esperienza, il tutto pur mantenendo proprietà meccaniche di livello commerciale.
In questo progetto PhD, sintetizzate e caratterizzate elastomeri in poliuretano semicristallina contenenti interruttori molecolari integrati a spina dorsale contenenti interruttori fotografici, alo- e termocromatici, e indagate su come le loro interazioni possono essere progettate per produrre comportamenti quantificabili di memoria e apprendimento.

I tuoi compiti

• Le librerie Synthesize dei poliuretani mono, dual e triple-switch (Stenhouse Salt, DASA e Spiropyran) tramite la copolimerizzazione e la funzionalità post-polimerizzazione, e convalidano l'integrazione della spina dorsale da NMR, GPC, DSC, DMA, test di trazione, spettroscopia UV-Vis e caratterizzazione della sonda della pompa.

• Progettare e caratterizzare le cascate di commutazione sinergica (percorsi collaborativi, competitivi e interdipendenti) utilizzando spettroscopia risolta nel tempo e risolta nello spazio, illuminazione modellata e stimoli pH/termali.

• Sviluppare e convalidare mappe logiche per la formazione della memoria, il consolidamento e la dimenticanza selettiva, e tradurre questi in cicli di formazione-recall-forgetting su film polimerici fisici e attuatori bilayer.

• Contribuire a integrare i materiali di apprendimento in morbidi attuatori bilayer robotici e, insieme al team più ampio, dimostrare l'adattamento comportamentale in robot morbidi autonomi.

• Collabora con partner internazionali

Il tuo profilo

Il candidato dovrebbe avere un forte background in chimica organica, chimica polimerica, scienza dei materiali, o un campo strettamente correlato. Stiamo cercando una persona molto motivata e curiosa che si diverte a lavorare all'interfaccia di chimica sintetica, scienza dei materiali e robotica morbida, che è confortevole in un ambiente multidisciplinare e collaborativo. Il candidato del dottorato deve essere altamente competente in inglese parlato e scritto e tenere un master. S/he parteciperà alla scrittura di pubblicazioni scientifiche e alla presentazione di dati a conferenze scientifiche nazionali e internazionali. È richiesta una precedente esperienza in una o più delle seguenti aree:
• Sintesi e caratterizzazione del polimero/poliuretano

• Interruttori molecolari (ad esempio, sistemi fotocromatici, alocromatici o termocromatici)

• Metodi analitici standard (NMR, UV-Vis, FTIR e tecniche correlate)

• Caratterizzazione termomeccanica dei polimeri (DSC, DMA, test di trazione) L'esperienza con attuatori morbidi o sistemi robotizzati morbidi è un plus ma non richiesto.

La nostra offerta

Questo progetto fa parte di una sovvenzione SNSF Ambizione guidata dal Dr. Livius F. Muff, ospitata nel gruppo del Dr. Luciano Boesel ad Empa. Il lavoro sarà svolto principalmente presso Empa St.Gallen sotto la supervisione diretta del Dr. Livius F. Muff. Lo studente di dottorato sarà affiliato a ETH Zürich (Prof. René Rossi, D-HEST).

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.
