Materialwissenschaft und -technologie sind unsere Leidenschaft. Mit unserer Spitzenforschung leisten die rund 1.100 Mitarbeiter der Empa wesentliche Beiträge zum Wohl der Gesellschaft für eine lebenswerte Zukunft. Die Empa ist eine Forschungseinrichtung des ETH-Bereichs.

PhD Position in der Entwicklung von lebensechten Materialien, die lernen, erinnern und vergessen für den Einsatz in der weichen Robotik

In unserer Forschungsgruppe entwickeln wir mechanisch robustes, multiresponsives Polyurethan-Elastomer mit Backbone-integrierten molekularen Schaltern. Unser Ziel ist es, über herkömmliche, auf Reize reagierende Materialien hinauszugehen, die lediglich zwischen vorbestimmten Zuständen wechseln, hin zu lebensähnlichen Materialien, die wirklich lernen: Erinnerungen bilden, sie im Laufe der Zeit konsolidieren, selektiv vergessen und ihr Verhalten durch Erfahrung anpassen, während sie gleichzeitig handelsübliche mechanische Eigenschaften beibehalten.
In diesem PhD-Projekt werden Sie halbkristalline Polyurethan-Elastomere synthetisieren und charakterisieren, die Backbone-integrierte photo-, halo- und thermochrome molekulare Schalter enthalten, und untersuchen, wie ihre Wechselwirkungen so konstruiert werden können, dass sie quantifizierbare Gedächtnis- und Lernverhalten erzeugen.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Synthetisieren Sie Bibliotheken von Einzel-, Dual- und Dreifachschalter-Polyurethanen (Stenhouse-Salz, DASA und Spiropyran) über Copolymerisation und Nachpolymerisationsfunktionalisierung und validieren Sie die Rückgratintegration durch NMR, GPC, DSC, DMA, Zugprüfung, UV-Vis-Spektroskopie und Pumpsondencharakterisierung.

• Entwerfen und charakterisieren Sie synergistische Schaltkaskaden (kollaborative, kompetitive und voneinander abhängige Pfade) mit zeitaufgelöster und ortsaufgelöster Spektroskopie, gemusterter Beleuchtung und pH-/thermischen Reizen.

• Entwickeln und validieren Sie Logikkarten für Gedächtnisbildung, Konsolidierung und selektives Vergessen und übersetzen Sie diese in Trainings-Rückruf-Vergessenszyklen auf physischen Polymerfilmen und Doppelschichtaktoren.

• Tragen Sie dazu bei, Lernmaterialien in weiche Roboter-Doppelschichtaktoren zu integrieren, und demonstrieren Sie zusammen mit dem breiteren Team Verhaltensanpassung bei autonomen weichen Robotern.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Partnern

Dein Profil

Der Kandidat sollte einen starken Hintergrund in organischer Chemie, Polymerchemie, Materialwissenschaft oder einem eng verwandten Bereich haben. Wir suchen eine hochmotivierte, neugierige Person, die gerne an der Schnittstelle von synthetischer Chemie, Materialwissenschaften und Soft Robotik arbeitet und sich in einer multidisziplinären, kollaborativen Umgebung wohlfühlt. Der Doktorand muss sehr gut in gesprochenem und geschriebenem Englisch sein und einen Master-Abschluss haben. S/er wird am Verfassen wissenschaftlicher Publikationen und der Präsentation von Daten auf nationalen und internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen teilnehmen. Vorkenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche sind erforderlich:
• Polymer/Polyurethan-Synthese und Charakterisierung

• Molekulare Schalter (z. B. photochrome, halochrome oder thermochrome Systeme)

• Standardanalysemethoden (NMR, UV-Vis, FTIR und verwandte Techniken)

• Thermomechanische Charakterisierung von Polymeren (DSC, DMA, Zugprüfung) Erfahrung mit weichen Aktoren oder weichen Robotersystemen ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

Unser Angebot

Dieses Projekt ist Teil eines SNF-Ambizione-Stipendiums unter der Leitung von Dr. Livius F. Muff, das in der Gruppe von Dr. Luciano Boesel an der Empa stattfindet. descriptionByLocale.fr:
La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à nos recherches de pointe, les quelque 1 100 employés d'Empa apportent une contribution essentielle au bien-être de la société pour un avenir digne d'être vécu. Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine ETH.

Position du doctorat dans le développement de matériaux comme la vie qui apprennent, se souviennent et oublient pour l'utilisation en robotique douce

Dans notre groupe de recherche, nous concevons un élastomère polyuréthane multiréaction mécaniquement robuste avec des interrupteurs moléculaires intégrés à la colonne vertébrale. Notre objectif est de passer au-delà des matériaux conventionnels réceptifs aux stimuli, qui se contentent de basculer entre des états prédéterminés, vers des matériaux ressemblant à la vie qui apprennent réellement : former des souvenirs, les consolider au fil du temps, oublier sélectivement, et adapter leur comportement par l'expérience, tout en conservant des propriétés mécaniques de qualité commerciale.
Dans ce projet de doctorat, vous synthétiserez et caractériserez des élastomères de polyuréthane semi-cristallin contenant des interrupteurs moléculaires photo-, halo- et thermochromiques intégrés à l'épine dorsale, et étudierez comment leurs interactions peuvent être conçues pour produire des comportements quantifiables en mémoire et en apprentissage.

Vos tâches

• Synthétiser les bibliothèques de polyuréthanes mono-, bi- et triple-interrupteurs (Stenhouse sel, DASA, et Spiropyran) par copolymérisation et après polymérisation, et valider l'intégration de la colonne vertébrale par NMR, GPC, DSC, DMA, essais de traction, spectroscopie UV-Vis et caractérisation de la sonde de pompe.

• Concevoir et caractériser des cascades de commutation synergiques (voies collaboratives, compétitives et interdépendantes) en utilisant la spectroscopie résolue dans le temps et résolue dans l'espace, l'éclairage à motifs et les stimuli pH/thermal.

• Élaborer et valider des cartes logiques pour la formation de la mémoire, la consolidation et l'oubli sélectif, et les traduire en cycles d'entraînement-appel-oubli sur les films de polymères physiques et les actionneurs bicouches.

• Contribuer à l'intégration du matériel d'apprentissage dans les actionneurs bicouches robotisés doux et, avec l'équipe élargie, démontrer l'adaptation comportementale dans les robots souples autonomes.

• Collaborer avec des partenaires internationaux

Votre profil

Le candidat devrait avoir une solide expérience en chimie organique, chimie du polymères, science des matériaux ou un domaine étroitement lié. Nous recherchons une personne très motivée et curieuse qui aime travailler à l'interface de la chimie synthétique, de la science des matériaux et de la robotique douce, qui est confortable dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et collaboratif. Le doctorant doit être très compétent en anglais parlé et écrit et détenir une maîtrise. Il participera à la rédaction de publications scientifiques et à la présentation de données lors de conférences scientifiques nationales et internationales. Une expérience antérieure dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants est requise :
• Synthèse et caractérisation des polymères/polyuréthanes

• Interrupteurs moléculaires (p. ex. systèmes photochromiques, halochromiques ou thermochromiques)

• Méthodes analytiques normalisées (RMN, UV-Vis, FTIR et techniques connexes)

• Caractérisation thermomécanique des polymères (DSC, DMA, essais de traction) L'expérience avec les actionneurs souples ou les systèmes robotiques souples est un plus mais pas nécessaire.

Notre offre

Ce projet s'inscrit dans le cadre d'une subvention de la SNSF Ambizione dirigée par le Dr Livius F. Muff, hébergée dans le groupe du Dr Luciano Boesel à Empa. Les travaux seront principalement effectués à Empa St.Gallen sous la supervision directe du Dr Livius F. Muff. Le doctorant sera affilié à l'ETH Zürich (Prof. René Rossi, D-HEST).

Nous vivons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui s'intéressent à des activités novatrices, durables et significatives - c'est ce qui compte.

Veuillez les soumettre exclusivement via notre portail d'emploi. Les demandes par courrier électronique et par la poste ne seront pas prises en considération.

 We are looking for a motivated researcher to join an interdisciplinary project focused on heat stress mitigation across multiple application domains, including buildings, sports, and occupational safety. The project will establish the scientific and methodological foundation for the development and validation of innovative strategies to protect people from heat stress and improve thermal safety, comfort, and performance in challenging environments.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 Postdoc position on redox-targeted flow batteries

 Empa’s Laboratory Materials for Energy Conversion focuses on materials and device innovation for sustainable energy conversion and storage technologies.

 The research project focuses on the development of solid electrode composites, so-called boosters, for next-generation redox-targeted flow batteries. In these systems, soluble redox mediators dissolved in the electrolyte exchange charge with solid booster materials held in the storage tanks, decoupling energy density from active-material solubility while preserving the modularity and safety of aqueous flow batteries. The performance of such batteries hinges on the solid booster formulation, morphology, and the efficiency of charge transfer between mediator and solid under continuous flow.

 Your tasks

 Your task is to develop solid booster formulations with PFAS-free binders, in line with the sustainability goals of the project. You will explore compositions and pellet morphologies to optimize mass transport and reactivity with the mediator solution while maintaining mechanical stability, and characterize the thermal and chemical stability of components and formulations. You will apply in-situ diagnostics, in particular in-flow UV-Vis, to quantify mediator-booster reactivity and component dissolution during operation, developing a firm understanding of how material formulation and experimental parameters govern charge transfer at the liquid-solid interface. To connect materials to devices, you will prototype booster-bed reactors from mL to L scale by 3D printing and support the transfer of promising formulations toward scalable, solvent-free processing. Material combinations will be validated in lab-scale flow batteries, benefiting from the characterization capabilities available at Empa. 

 The position is embedded in the Horizon Europe project FLOWBOOST, an international consortium advancing the technology from the laboratory toward a kW-scale prototype, offering close collaboration with academic and industrial partners across Europe.

 Your profile

 We are looking for a self-motivated team player ready to work independently in Empa's vibrant international research environment. The ideal candidate holds a PhD in materials science, chemistry, or related fields, with a strong publication record. Prior experience in flow-cell electrochemistry, in-situ spectroscopy (UV-Vis, Raman, FTIR), or 3D printing and polymer processing is desired. Good spoken and written English is required, and basic German is an advantage.

 Our offer

 Our labs are fully equipped for battery fabrication and characterization. State-of-the-art facilities include synthesis labs with fume hoods, gloveboxes, various synthesis reactors and furnaces, several lab-scale flow battery test stands, 3D printers for rapid reactor prototyping, and equipment for electrode and composite fabrication. Analytical facilities include X-ray diffractometers, UV-Vis (including in-flow configurations), Raman and FTIR spectrometers, surface area and particle size analyzers, electrochemical characterization including impedance spectroscopy, mass spectrometers, gas and liquid chromatographers, thermogravimetric analysis, elemental analysis (ICP-OES), and a broad suite of tools for the physicochemical characterization of components. Access to advanced electron microscopy and X-ray facilities is also available.

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including your CV, scholar records and certificates, a full publication list, a one-page motivation letter specifying how you intend to contribute to this specific topic, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Posizione Postdoc sulle batterie di flusso arrossate

I Materiali di Laboratorio di Empa per la Conversione Energetica si concentrano sull’innovazione dei materiali e dei dispositivi per la conversione sostenibile dell’energia e le tecnologie di storage.

Il progetto di ricerca si concentra sullo sviluppo di solidi compositi elettrodi, cosiddetti booster, per batterie di flusso arrossate di nuova generazione. In questi sistemi, i mediatori solubili redox si dissolrono nella carica di scambio elettrolitico con materiali solidi booster detenuti nei serbatoi di stoccaggio, decoupling della densità energetica dalla solubilità attiva-materiale, preservando la modularità e la sicurezza delle batterie di flusso acquose. Le prestazioni di tali batterie cerniere sulla solida formulazione booster, morfologia, e l'efficienza del trasferimento di carica tra mediatore e solido sotto flusso continuo.

I tuoi compiti

Il vostro compito è quello di sviluppare formulazioni di booster solidi con leganti privi di PFAS, in linea con gli obiettivi di sostenibilità del progetto. Esplorerete composizioni e morfologie di pellet per ottimizzare il trasporto di massa e la reattività con la soluzione mediatrice mantenendo la stabilità meccanica e caratterizzando la stabilità termica e chimica dei componenti e delle formulazioni. Si applica la diagnostica in-situ, in particolare UV-Vis a flusso in-situ, per quantificare la reattività mediatore-booster e la dissoluzione dei componenti durante il funzionamento, sviluppando una solida comprensione di come la formulazione materiale e i parametri sperimentali governano il trasferimento di carica all'interfaccia liquida-solid. Per collegare i materiali ai dispositivi, si prototificherà reattori a base di booster dalla scala mL a L tramite stampa 3D e sostenere il trasferimento di formulazioni promettenti verso la lavorazione scalabile e senza solventi. Le combinazioni di materiali saranno convalidate in batterie di flusso su scala di laboratorio, beneficiando delle capacità di caratterizzazione disponibili presso Empa.

La posizione è incorporata nel progetto Horizon Europe FLOWBOOST, un consorzio internazionale che promuove la tecnologia dal laboratorio verso un prototipo di kW, offrendo una stretta collaborazione con partner accademici e industriali in tutta Europa.

È richiesto un buon inglese parlato e scritto, e il tedesco di base è un vantaggio.

Le strutture analitiche includono diffrattometri a raggi X, UV-Vis (comprese le configurazioni di flusso), spettrometri Raman e FTIR, area superficiale e analizzatori di dimensioni particellari, caratterizzazione elettrochimica tra cui spettroscopia di impedenza, spettrometri di massa, cromatografi gas e liquidi, analisi termogravimetrica, analisi elementale (ICP-OES), e una vasta gamma di strumenti per la caratterizzazione fisica. È disponibile anche l'accesso alla microscopia elettronica avanzata e ai raggi X.

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Empa’s Laboratory Materials for Energy Conversion focuses on materials and device innovation for sustainable energy conversion and storage technologies.

The research project focuses on the development of solid electrode composites, so-called boosters, for next-generation redox-targeted flow batteries. In these systems, soluble redox mediators dissolved in the electrolyte exchange charge with solid booster materials held in the storage tanks, decoupling energy density from active-material solubility while preserving the modularity and safety of aqueous flow batteries. The performance of such batteries hinges on the solid booster formulation, morphology, and the efficiency of charge transfer between mediator and solid under continuous flow.

Your tasks

Your task is to develop solid booster formulations with PFAS-free binders, in line with the sustainability goals of the project. You will explore compositions and pellet morphologies to optimize mass transport and reactivity with the mediator solution while maintaining mechanical stability, and characterize the thermal and chemical stability of components and formulations. You will apply in-situ diagnostics, in particular in-flow UV-Vis, to quantify mediator-booster reactivity and component dissolution during operation, developing a firm understanding of how material formulation and experimental parameters govern charge transfer at the liquid-solid interface. To connect materials to devices, you will prototype booster-bed reactors from mL to L scale by 3D printing and support the transfer of promising formulations toward scalable, solvent-free processing. Material combinations will be validated in lab-scale flow batteries, benefiting from the characterization capabilities available at Empa.

The position is embedded in the Horizon Europe project FLOWBOOST, an international consortium advancing the technology from the laboratory toward a kW-scale prototype, offering close collaboration with academic and industrial partners across Europe.

Your profile

We are looking for a self-motivated team player ready to work independently in Empa's vibrant international research environment. The ideal candidate holds a PhD in materials science, chemistry, or related fields, with a strong publication record. Prior experience in flow-cell electrochemistry, in-situ spectroscopy (UV-Vis, Raman, FTIR), or 3D printing and polymer processing is desired. Good spoken and written English is required, and basic German is an advantage.

Our offer

Our labs are fully equipped for battery fabrication and characterization. State-of-the-art facilities include synthesis labs with fume hoods, gloveboxes, various synthesis reactors and furnaces, several lab-scale flow battery test stands, 3D printers for rapid reactor prototyping, and equipment for electrode and composite fabrication. Analytical facilities include X-ray diffractometers, UV-Vis (including in-flow configurations), Raman and FTIR spectrometers, surface area and particle size analyzers, electrochemical characterization including impedance spectroscopy, mass spectrometers, gas and liquid chromatographers, thermogravimetric analysis, elemental analysis (ICP-OES), and a broad suite of tools for the physicochemical characterization of components. Access to advanced electron microscopy and X-ray facilities is also available.

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including your CV, scholar records and certificates, a full publication list, a one-page motivation letter specifying how you intend to contribute to this specific topic, and at least two reference letters. Only complete applications will be considered. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Postdoc-Position zu Redox-gezielten Durchflussbatterien

Die Empa Labormaterialien für Energieumwandlung konzentriert sich auf Material- und Geräteinnovationen für nachhaltige Energieumwandlungs- und Speichertechnologien.

Das Forschungsprojekt konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung von festen Elektrodenverbundwerkstoffen, sogenannten Boostern, für Redox-gezielte Durchflussbatterien der nächsten Generation. Bei diesen Systemen tauschen lösliche Redoxmediatoren, die in der Elektrolytladung gelöst sind, mit festen Boostermaterialien aus, die in den Lagertanks aufbewahrt werden, wodurch die Energiedichte von der Löslichkeit des aktiven Materials entkoppelt wird, während die Modularität und Sicherheit von wässrigen Durchflussbatterien erhalten bleibt. Die Leistung solcher Batterien hängt von der Feststoff-Booster-Formulierung, Morphologie und der Effizienz der Ladungsübertragung zwischen Mediator und Feststoff im kontinuierlichen Fluss ab.

Ihre Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgabe ist es, feste Booster-Formulierungen mit PFAS-freien Bindemitteln im Einklang mit den Nachhaltigkeitszielen des Projekts zu entwickeln. Sie werden Zusammensetzungen und Pelletmorphologien untersuchen, um den Massentransport und die Reaktivität mit der Mediatorlösung unter Beibehaltung der mechanischen Stabilität zu optimieren und die thermische und chemische Stabilität von Komponenten und Formulierungen zu charakterisieren. Sie werden In-situ-Diagnostik, insbesondere In-Flow-UV-Vis, anwenden, um die Mediator-Booster-Reaktivität und Komponentenauflösung während des Betriebs zu quantifizieren und ein festes Verständnis dafür zu entwickeln, wie die Materialformulierung und experimentelle Parameter den Ladungstransfer an der Flüssig-Feststoff-Grenzfläche steuern. Um Materialien mit Geräten zu verbinden, prototypisieren Sie Booster-Bett-Reaktoren im mL- bis L-Maßstab durch 3D-Druck und unterstützen den Transfer vielversprechender Formulierungen in Richtung skalierbarer, lösungsmittelfreier Verarbeitung. Materialkombinationen werden in Durchflussbatterien im Labormaßstab validiert und profitieren von den an der Empa verfügbaren Charakterisierungsmöglichkeiten.

Die Position ist eingebettet in das Horizon Europe-Projekt FLOWBOOST, ein internationales Konsortium, das die Technologie vom Labor zu einem Prototyp im kW-Maßstab vorantreibt und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit akademischen und industriellen Partnern in ganz Europa anbietet.

Wir suchen einen selbstmotivierten Teamplayer, der bereit ist, selbstständig im pulsierenden internationalen Forschungsumfeld der Empa zu arbeiten. Der ideale Kandidat hat einen Doktortitel in Materialwissenschaften, Chemie oder verwandten Bereichen mit einer starken Publikationsbilanz. Analytische Einrichtungen umfassen Röntgendiffraktometer, UV-Vis (einschließlich In-Flow-Konfigurationen), Raman- und FTIR-Spektrometer, Oberflächen- und Partikelgrößenanalysatoren, elektrochemische Charakterisierung einschließlich Impedanzspektroskopie, Massenspektrometer, Gas- und Flüssigkeitschromatographen, thermogravimetrische Analyse, Elementaranalyse (ICP-OES) und eine breite Palette von Werkzeugen für die physikalisch-chemische Charakterisierung von Komponenten. Zugang zu fortschrittlicher Elektronenmikroskopie und Röntgenanlagen ist ebenfalls verfügbar.

Position postdoc sur les batteries à flux redox

Les matériaux de laboratoire pour la conversion de l'énergie sont axés sur l'innovation des matériaux et des appareils pour les technologies de conversion et de stockage durables de l'énergie.

Le projet de recherche est axé sur le développement de composites d'électrodes solides, dits boosters, pour les batteries à flux redox de nouvelle génération. Dans ces systèmes, des médiateurs rédox solubles se sont dissous dans la charge d'échange électrolyte avec des matériaux d'appoint solides maintenus dans les réservoirs de stockage, découplant la densité d'énergie de la solubilité active-matériau tout en préservant la modularité et la sécurité des batteries à flux aqueux. La performance de ces batteries repose sur la formulation de booster solide, la morphologie et l'efficacité du transfert de charge entre médiateur et solide sous flux continu.

Vos tâches

Votre tâche est de développer des formulations de booster solides avec des liants sans SPAS, conformément aux objectifs de durabilité du projet. Vous explorerez les compositions et les morphologies des granulés pour optimiser le transport de masse et la réactivité avec la solution médiateur tout en maintenant la stabilité mécanique, et caractériser la stabilité thermique et chimique des composants et formulations. Vous appliquerez des diagnostics in-situ, en particulier UV-Vis in-flow, pour quantifier la réactivité médiateur-booster et la dissolution des composants pendant le fonctionnement, en développant une compréhension ferme de la façon dont la formulation des matériaux et les paramètres expérimentaux régissent le transfert de charge à l'interface liquide-solide. Pour relier les matériaux aux appareils, vous allez prototyper des réacteurs à lit d'appoint de mL à l'échelle L par l'impression 3D et soutenir le transfert de formulations prometteuses vers un traitement évolutif et sans solvant. Les combinaisons de matériaux seront validées dans les batteries à débit de laboratoire, bénéficiant des capacités de caractérisation disponibles à Empa.

La position est ancrée dans le projet Horizon Europe FLOWBOOST, un consortium international qui fait progresser la technologie du laboratoire vers un prototype à l'échelle kW, offrant une collaboration étroite avec des partenaires universitaires et industriels dans toute l'Europe.

Votre profil

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un joueur d'équipe auto-motivé prêt à travailler de manière indépendante dans l'environnement de recherche international dynamique d'Empa. Le candidat idéal détient un doctorat en sciences des matériaux, en chimie ou dans des domaines connexes, avec un solide dossier de publication. Une expérience préalable en électrochimie des cellules de flux, en spectroscopie in situ (UV-Vis, Raman, FTIR) ou en impression 3D et en traitement des polymères est souhaitée. Un anglais bien parlé et écrit est requis, et l'allemand de base est un avantage.

Notre offre

Nos laboratoires sont entièrement équipés pour la fabrication et la caractérisation des batteries. Les installations les plus modernes comprennent des laboratoires de synthèse avec hottes à fumée, boîtes à gants, divers réacteurs et fours de synthèse, plusieurs bancs d'essai de batteries à débit de laboratoire, des imprimantes 3D pour le prototypage rapide des réacteurs et des équipements pour la fabrication d'électrodes et de composites. Les installations d'analyse comprennent les diffractomètres à rayons X, les UV-Vis (y compris les configurations en débit), les spectromètres Raman et FTIR, les analyseurs de surface et de granulométrie, la caractérisation électrochimique incluant la spectroscopie d'impédance, les spectromètres de masse, les chromatographes de gaz et de liquides, l'analyse thermogravimétrique, l'analyse élémentaire (ICP-OES) et une vaste gamme d'outils pour la caractérisation physicochimique des composants. L'accès aux installations avancées de microscopie électronique et de radiographie est également disponible.

Nous vivons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui s'intéressent à des activités novatrices, durables et significatives - c'est ce qui compte.

Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature en ligne complète, y compris votre CV, vos dossiers d'études et vos certificats, une liste de publications complète, une lettre de motivation d'une page précisant comment vous comptez contribuer à ce sujet spécifique et au moins deux lettres de référence. jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 PhD Position on Nanozyme-based coating for antimicrobial implants

 The Nanomaterials in Health Lab is a truly interdisciplinary environment that conducts pioneered investigations on particle bio-functionalization, particles uptake, accumulation, translocation across biological barriers and their bio-responses. With this we provide key contributions to novel personalized strategies of particles de-sign for drug delivery, imaging or diagnosis. This PhD project will develop stimuli-responsive nanozyme coatings for personalized medical implants. Nanozymes are nanomaterials capable of mimicking the catalytic activity of natural enzymes and can be engineered to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) locally and in a controlled manner. The position is within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network Implant-to-Market (i2M), providing an international and interdisciplinary training environment connecting materials science, biology, medical devices and regulatory science.

 Your tasks

 
• Design and synthesize nanozymes: Develop nanozymes, and optimize their physicochemical and catalytic properties. 

• Develop functional implant coatings: Establish reproducible strategies for integrating nanozymes onto implant surfaces and investigate their compatibility with different implant architectures and surface modifications. 

• Evaluate antimicrobial activity: Investigate the ability of nanozyme-coated surfaces to inhibit bacterial growth and biofilm formation while reducing reliance on conventional antibiotics. 

• Investigate nano–bio interactions: Study cellular responses to nanozyme-coated implants, including cytocompatibility, macrophage activation, cytokine production and parameters related to osteointe-gration. 

• Study stability, ageing and biodegradation: Investigate the transformation of low-dimensional nanozyme coatings in biologically relevant fluids.
 

 Your profile

 
• Motivation and Commitments to dive into an interdisciplinary challenge 

• Completed Master’s degree in biomaterials, chemistry, nanotechnology, or biomedical engineering. 

• Experience in nanomaterial synthesis and characterization. 

• Familiarity with cell culture and in vitro assays. 

• Experience in catalysis, programming and large data analysis is a plus. 

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English (written and oral).
 

 Our offer

 The project is planned for 3 years and will be carried out as a PhD thesis. It is supported by Empa under the supervision of Dr. Giacomo Reina. The candidate will perform research at Empa in St. Gallen with joint affilia-tion to ETH Zürich (D-HEST, Prof. Peter Wick). Desired starting date is upon mutual agreement.

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Position du doctorat sur le revêtement à base de nanozymes pour les implants antimicrobiens

Les nanomatériaux dans le laboratoire de santé est un environnement véritablement interdisciplinaire qui mène des enquêtes pionnières sur la biofonctionnalisation des particules, l'absorption des particules, l'accumulation, la translocation entre les barrières biologiques et leurs bio-réponses. Nous apportons ainsi des contributions clés à de nouvelles stratégies personnalisées de désignation des particules pour la délivrance, l'imagerie ou le diagnostic des médicaments. Ce projet de doctorat développera des revêtements nanozymatiques sensibles aux stimuli pour des implants médicaux personnalisés. Les nanozymes sont des nanomatériaux capables d'imiter l'activité catalytique des enzymes naturelles et peuvent être conçus pour générer localement et de manière contrôlée des espèces d'oxygène réactif (ROS). Ce poste fait partie du Réseau doctoral Marie Skłodowska-Curie Implant-to-Market (i2M), offrant un environnement de formation international et interdisciplinaire reliant la science des matériaux, la biologie, les dispositifs médicaux et la science réglementaire.

Vos tâches

• Concevoir et synthétiser des nanozymes : Développer des nanozymes et optimiser leurs propriétés physicochimiques et catalytiques.

• Développer des revêtements d'implant fonctionnels : Établir des stratégies reproductibles pour intégrer les nanozymes sur les surfaces des implants et étudier leur compatibilité avec différentes architectures d'implant et modifications de surface.

• Évaluer l'activité antimicrobienne : Étudier la capacité des surfaces enrobées de nanozymes à inhiber la croissance bactérienne et la formation de biofilms tout en réduisant la dépendance aux antibiotiques conventionnels.

• Étudier les interactions nano-bio : étudier les réponses cellulaires aux implants enrobés de nanozymes, y compris la cytocompatibilité, l'activation des macrophages, la production de cytokines et les paramètres liés à l'ostéo-intégration.

• Étudier la stabilité, le vieillissement et la biodégradation : étudier la transformation des revêtements nanozymatiques à faible dimension dans les fluides biologiquement pertinents.

Votre profil

• Motivation et engagements à plonger dans un défi interdisciplinaire

• Maîtrise en biomatériaux, chimie, nanotechnologie ou génie biomédical.

Le projet est prévu pour 3 ans et sera réalisé en tant que thèse de doctorat. Il est soutenu par Empa sous la supervision du Dr Giacomo Reina.  PhD student in the synthesis of polymeric materials

 For an EU grant at the Laboratory for Functional Polymers , we are searching a motivated PhD student.

 

 You will work on a research project in the field of novel dielectric elastic materials.  We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

La scienza e la tecnologia materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca di alto livello, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa contribuiscono in modo decisivo al benessere della società per un futuro degno di essere vissuto. Empa è un istituto di ricerca della divisione ETH.

Trainer/elettro-installer (a)

Per l'agosto 2027, vi offriamo un luogo di formazione impegnativo nel dipartimento Immobiliare in un ambiente di ricerca affascinante.

I tuoi compiti

Lavorare in un istituto di ricerca ETH porta molte varietà al lavoro quotidiano. Il versatile e le attività emozionanti nella nostra infrastruttura nel campus di Dübendorf in un ambiente internazionale garantiscono ai giovani un insegnamento di laurea. Vicino alla ricerca e allo sviluppo fai parte del nostro team di supporto e aiuta a mantenere l'infrastruttura in tutti gli edifici del campus. Con un apprendistato come elettroinstaller si avvia il collegamento dalle distribuzioni attraverso la misurazione e il passaggio punti per l'utente di energia.

Siete anche coinvolti nel supporto delle nostre varie reti di comunicazione e di segnale e siete responsabili della correzione dei malfunzionamenti.

Il tuo profilo

La scuola secondaria è presto storia e la completi con buoni risultati in matematica, geometria e fisica. Il tuo interesse per l'ingegneria e l'ingegneria elettrica, insieme al tuo senso di connessioni pratiche e teoriche, ti supportano nel tuo tempo di insegnamento. Porti una comprensione rapida e una buona memoria, come il lavoro manuale e sono persistenti. Apprezziamo anche la cura e l'affidabilità, così come la responsabilità e il lavoro di coscienza. Non da ultimo, una normale resistenza al colore è un must.

La nostra offerta

• Un corso di formazione di base per apparecchiature elettriche e possibilità di collegamento per apparecchiature e macchine

• Impari a creare connessioni dalle distribuzioni attraverso la misurazione e il passaggio dei punti al consumo energetico e poi puoi risolvere i guasti da solo

• Un'officina elettrica equipaggiata con strumenti e attrezzature moderne

• Formatori professionali impegnati e qualificati

• Frequenta la scuola professionale di Wetzikon

• La visita del BMS è sostenuta

Offriamo una formazione emozionante con la tecnologia più moderna. Empa è un ambiente di ricerca vivace e innovativo con un tocco internazionale e condizioni di lavoro eccellenti nella Agglomeration Zurigo.

"a" sta per "tutti" nelle nostre liste di lavoro. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Accogliamo tutte le persone che sono in vena di attività innovative, sostenibili e soleggiate.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua domanda online completa, comprese lettere motivazionali, CV e certificati. Ti preghiamo di inviarli esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale applicativo. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno prese in considerazione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Material science and technology are our passion. With our top-level research, the approximately 1,100 employees of Empa make a decisive contribution to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH division.

Trainer/electro-installer (a)

For August 2027, we offer you a challenging training place in the Real Estate department in a fascinating research environment.

Your tasks

Working at an ETH research institute brings a lot of variety to everyday work. The versatile and exciting tasks in our infrastructure on the Dübendorf campus in an international environment guarantee young people a versatile teaching. Close to research and development you are part of our support team and help to maintain the infrastructure in all buildings on the campus. With an apprenticeship as an electroinstaller you start the connection from distributions through measuring and switching points to the energy user.

You are also involved in the support of our various communication and signal networks and are responsible for the correction of malfunctions.

Your profile

The secondary school is soon history and you complete it with good achievements in mathematics, geometry and physics. Your interest in engineering and electrical engineering, coupled with your sense of practical and theoretical connections, support you in your teaching time. You bring a quick understanding and a good memory, like manual work and are persistent. We also appreciate care and reliability as well as responsibility and conscientious work. Not least, a normal colour-proofness is a must.

Our offer

• A versatile basic training for electrical equipment and connection options for equipment and machines

• You learn to create connections from distributions through measurement and switching points to the energy consumption and can then fix faults by yourself

• A top equipped electric workshop with modern tools and equipment

• Committed and qualified professional trainers

• You are attending the vocational school in Wetzikon

• The visit of the BMS is supported

We offer an exciting training with the most modern technology. Empa is a vibrant and innovative research environment with an international flair and excellent employment conditions in the Agglomeration Zurich.

"a" stands for "all" in our job listings. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are in the mood for innovative, sustainable and sun-drenched activities – that's all that counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including motivational letters, CV and certificates. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be taken into account.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

La scienza e la tecnologia dei materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 collaboratori dell'Empa danno un contributo decisivo al benessere della società e ad un futuro degno di essere vissuto. L'Empa è un istituto di ricerca del settore dei PF.

Capogruppo elettrico 80% - 100% (a)

Il Gruppo Elettrico all'interno dei Servizi Tecnici garantisce il funzionamento sicuro e affidabile di un'infrastruttura di ricerca all'avanguardia. I nostri sistemi di ingegneria elettrica spaziano dai classici impianti tecnologici per l'edilizia alla ricerca sofisticata e alle installazioni speciali. Per rafforzare il nostro team, stiamo cercando un leader impegnato che combini la sua approfondita esperienza elettrica con la passione per la leadership, la formazione e la cooperazione pratica. La funzione comprende sia la responsabilità di leadership che la partecipazione attiva a sistemi tecnici complessi.

Compiti

- Gestione professionale e del personale del Gruppo Elettrico nonché promozione e ulteriore sviluppo dei dipendenti e degli apprendisti
- Responsabilità per il funzionamento sicuro, economico e senza problemi dell'infrastruttura elettrica
- Partecipazione attiva a impegnativi lavori di installazione, risoluzione dei problemi e manutenzione
- Pianificazione e implementazione di misure di manutenzione, riparazione e ottimizzazione
- Garantire la disponibilità e la sicurezza operativa dei sistemi ad alta e bassa tensione e di altri sistemi elettrici
- Supportare progetti infrastrutturali ed elettrici e fornire suggerimenti di ottimizzazione
- Responsabilità per la formazione dei nostri apprendisti elettricisti EFZ
- Partecipazione al servizio di guardia come previsto

Requisiti

- Formazione come elettricista EFZ con perfezionamento nella gestione di progetti elettrici o qualifica comparabile
- Costituisce titolo preferenziale il corso di formazione professionale
- Esperienza professionale e gestionale pluriennale nel settore elettrico
- Conoscenza approfondita di impianti elettrici, norme e regolamenti (NIV, NIN, ESTI, SUVA ecc.)
- Esperienza nella conduzione e manutenzione di impianti di media e bassa tensione
- Divertiti a gestire i dipendenti e a formare gli studenti
- Metodo di lavoro strutturato, orientato alla soluzione e responsabile
- Mentalità pratica e piacere di essere coinvolti personalmente nel lavoro tecnico

Offriamo

Con noi puoi aspettarti un ruolo di leadership vario in un ambiente di ricerca unico. Ti assumi la responsabilità di un'infrastruttura elettrica diversificata e lavori quotidianamente con specialisti dedicati. Unirai compiti di leadership con lavoro tecnico pratico e darai un contributo diretto al successo della ricerca presso l'Empa.

Ti offriamo:

- Una posizione di leadership responsabile con grande spazio per la creatività
- Strutture tecniche e sfide entusiasmanti
- Una squadra motivata e collegiale
- Interessanti opportunità di formazione continua e di sviluppo
- Condizioni di lavoro all'avanguardia e vantaggi sociali del settore dei PF
- Sede di lavoro a Dübendorf
- Data di inizio dal 1 ottobre 2026 o previo accordo

Contatto

Nei nostri annunci di lavoro “a” sta per “all”. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone interessate ad attività innovative, sostenibili e significative: questo è tutto ciò che conta.

Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa. Si prega di inviarlo esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature inviate via e-mail o posta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's approximately 1,100 employees make crucial contributions to the well-being of society and to a future worth living. Empa is a research institution in the ETH domain.

Group leader electrical 80% - 100% (a)

The Electrical Group within the Technical Services ensures the safe and reliable operation of a state-of-the-art research infrastructure. Our electrical engineering systems range from classic building technology systems to sophisticated research and special installations. To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed leader who combines her in-depth electrical expertise with a passion for leadership, training and practical work. The function includes both leadership responsibility and active participation in complex technical systems.

Tasks

- Professional and personnel management of the Electrical Group as well as the promotion and further development of employees and apprentices
- Responsibility for the safe, economical and trouble-free operation of the electrical infrastructure
- Active participation in demanding installation, troubleshooting and maintenance work
- Planning and implementation of maintenance, repair and optimization measures
- Ensuring the availability and operational safety of high and low voltage systems as well as other electrical systems
- Supporting infrastructure and electrical projects and making optimization suggestions
- Responsibility for the training of our apprentice electricians EFZ
- Participation in on-call duty as planned

Requirements

- Training as an EFZ electrician with further training in electrical project management or a comparable qualification
- Vocational trainer course is an advantage
- Several years of professional and management experience in the electrical sector
- Sound knowledge of electrical systems, standards and regulations (NIV, NIN, ESTI, SUVA etc.)
- Experience in the operation and maintenance of medium and low voltage systems
- Enjoy managing employees and training learners
- Structured, solution-oriented and responsible way of working
- Hands-on mentality and enjoyment of being involved in technical work yourself

We offer

With us you can expect a varied leadership role in a unique research environment. You take responsibility for a diverse electrical infrastructure and work daily with dedicated specialists. You will combine leadership tasks with practical technical work and make a direct contribution to the success of research at Empa.

We offer you:

- A responsible leadership position with great scope for creativity
- Technical facilities and exciting challenges
- A motivated and collegial team
- Attractive further training and development opportunities
- Progressive working conditions and social benefits of the ETH Domain
- Place of work in Dübendorf
- Start date as of October 1st, 2026 or by arrangement

Contact

“a” stands for “all” in our job advertisements. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's all that counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application. Please submit this exclusively via our application portal. Applications by email or post will not be considered.

Descriptif

La science et la technologie des matériaux sont notre passion. Grâce à notre recherche de pointe, les quelque 1 100 collaborateurs de l'Empa apportent une contribution cruciale au bien-être de la société et à un avenir digne d'être vécu. L'Empa est une institution de recherche du domaine des EPF.

Chef de groupe électrique 80% - 100% (a)

Le groupe électrique au sein des services techniques assure le fonctionnement sûr et fiable d’une infrastructure de recherche de pointe. Nos systèmes d'électrotechnique vont des systèmes classiques de technique du bâtiment à la recherche sophistiquée et aux installations spéciales. Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une leader engagée qui allie son expertise approfondie en électricité à une passion pour le leadership, la formation et les travaux pratiques. La fonction comprend à la fois une responsabilité de leadership et une participation active à des systèmes techniques complexes.

Tâches

- Gestion professionnelle et du personnel du groupe électrique ainsi que la promotion et le développement des employés et des apprentis
- Responsabilité du fonctionnement sûr, économique et sans problème de l'infrastructure électrique
- Participation active aux travaux exigeants d'installation, de dépannage et de maintenance
- Planification et mise en œuvre des mesures de maintenance, de réparation et d'optimisation
- Assurer la disponibilité et la sécurité de fonctionnement des systèmes haute et basse tension ainsi que des autres systèmes électriques

Exigences

- Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle et de gestion dans le secteur électrique
- Bonne connaissance des systèmes électriques, des normes et réglementations (NIV, NIN, ESTI, SUVA etc.)
- Expérience dans l'exploitation et la maintenance de systèmes moyenne et basse tension

Nous offrons

Avec nous, vous pouvez vous attendre à un rôle de leadership varié dans un environnement de recherche unique. Vous prenez la responsabilité d'une infrastructure électrique diversifiée et travaillez au quotidien avec des spécialistes dédiés. Vous combinerez des tâches de direction avec des travaux techniques pratiques et apporterez une contribution directe au succès de la recherche à l'Empa.

Nous vous proposons :

- Un poste de direction responsable avec une grande marge de créativité
- Des installations techniques et des défis passionnants
- Une équipe motivée et collégiale
- Des opportunités attractives de formation continue et de développement
- Conditions de travail progressives et prestations sociales du Domaine des EPF

Contacter

« a » signifie « tous » dans nos offres d'emploi. Nous vivons une culture d’inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes intéressées par des activités innovantes, durables et porteuses de sens, c'est tout ce qui compte.

Nous attendons avec impatience de recevoir votre candidature en ligne complète. Veuillez le soumettre exclusivement via notre portail de candidature. Les candidatures par email ou par courrier ne seront pas prises en compte.

jobs.description:
Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain.

 System-Engineer Cell Culture Automation 80 - 100%

 The Nanomaterials in Health department at Empa St. Gallen is a highly motivated team of biologists, chemists and bioinformaticians. Our aim is understanding and controlling the interactions between (nano)materials and biological systems. To this end, we develop practical, clinically and diagnostically relevant cell-based models such as co-cultures and organoids.

 Your tasks

 As a specialist in cell culture automation, you will be responsible for the end-to-end development and maintenance of complex cell cultures, from concept to implementation. Specifically, this includes: 
• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop concepts for automating complex cell culture processes using robotics

• Conduct needs analyses to define the required system specifications and functional requirements

• Support the Laboratory Head in evaluating, comparing and selecting suitable robotic systems and assist throughout the procurement process

• Lead the implementation of the selected system, including its configuration and the programming of automated workflows and procedures
 

 Your profile

 
• Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or equivalent education 

• At least 3 years of professional experience in programming and operating laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems, as well as in related quality management

• Experience in adapting and optimizing cell-based and in vitro assays 

• Knowledge of mammalian cell culture systems and 3D cell cultures (organoids) 

• Expertise in software such as R, KNIME or Python 

• An independent, reliable and goal-oriented work style

• You are not afraid to take on responsibility, tackle new tasks and independently acquire the necessary expertise 

• You have an open and communicative personality and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment 

• Good oral and written proficiency in German and English is required: You must be fluent in everyday use of both languages
 

 Our offer

 
• A challenging and varied role in the field of cutting-edge international research

• Progressive working conditions, an open work environment, excellent opportunities for professional development and a modern workplace in St. Gallen 

• Initial 2-year fixed-term position—with the possibility of extension

• Flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, knowledge exchange, working together in a team 

• Ideal starting date: 1 November 2026 or upon agreement
 

 We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

 We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, reporting on 1 - 2 representative tasks / experiences supporting your skills (see application process), CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La scienza dei materiali e la tecnologia sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 dipendenti di Empa danno un contributo essenziale al benessere della società per un futuro che vale la pena di vivere. Empa è un'istituzione di ricerca del dominio ETH.

System-Engineer Cell Culture Automation 80 - 100%

Il Nanomaterials in Health Department di Empa St. Gallen è un team altamente motivato di biologi, chimici e bioinformatici. Il nostro obiettivo è la comprensione e il controllo delle interazioni tra (nano)materiali e sistemi biologici. A tal fine, sviluppiamo modelli pratici, clinicamente e diagnosticamente rilevanti a base cellulare come co-culture e organoidi.

I tuoi compiti

Come specialista nell'automazione della cultura cellulare, sarete responsabili dello sviluppo end-to-end e della manutenzione di culture cellulari complesse, dal concetto all'implementazione. In particolare, questo include:
• Collaborare con un team multidisciplinare per sviluppare concetti per automatizzare processi complessi di coltura cellulare utilizzando la robotica

• Condurre ha bisogno di analisi per definire le specifiche del sistema richieste e i requisiti funzionali

• Sostenere la Testa di Laboratorio nella valutazione, nel confronto e nella selezione di sistemi robotici adatti e nell'assistenza durante il processo di approvvigionamento

• Condurre l'implementazione del sistema selezionato, compresa la configurazione e la programmazione dei flussi di lavoro automatizzati e delle procedure

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea magistrale in scienze della vita, ingegneria o istruzione equivalente

• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale nella programmazione e nell'automazione del laboratorio operativo e nei sistemi di gestione dei liquidi, nonché nella gestione della qualità

• Esperienza nell'adattamento e nell'ottimizzazione delle analisi basate sulle cellule e in vitro

• Conoscenza dei sistemi di coltura cellulare dei mammiferi e delle culture cellulari 3D (organoidi)

• Competenza in software come R, KNIME o Python

• Uno stile di lavoro indipendente, affidabile e mirato

• Non hai paura di assumerti la responsabilità, affrontare nuovi compiti e acquisire in modo indipendente le competenze necessarie

• Hai una personalità aperta e comunicativa e ti piace lavorare in un ambiente multidisciplinare

• È richiesta una buona conoscenza orale e scritta in tedesco e inglese: Devi essere fluente nell'uso quotidiano di entrambe le lingue

La nostra offerta

• Un ruolo impegnativo e vario nel campo della ricerca internazionale all'avanguardia

• Condizioni di lavoro progressive, un ambiente di lavoro aperto, ottime opportunità di sviluppo professionale e un luogo di lavoro moderno a St. Gallen

• Posizione fissa iniziale di 2 anni — con possibilità di proroga

• Ore lavorative flessibili, gerarchie piatte, scambio di conoscenze, lavorare insieme in un team

• Data di partenza ideale: 1 novembre 2026 o su accordo

Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone che sono interessate a attività innovative, sostenibili e significative - questo è ciò che conta.

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua applicazione online completa, tra cui una lettera di motivazione, segnalazione su 1 - 2 compiti rappresentativi / esperienze che supportano le tue competenze (vedi processo di applicazione), CV, certificati, diplomi e dettagli di contatto di due persone di riferimento. Si prega di inviare questi esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di lavoro. Le domande per e-mail e per posta non saranno considerate.

• Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to develop concepts for automating complex cell culture processes using robotics

• Conduct needs analyses to define the required system specifications and functional requirements

• Support the Laboratory Head in evaluating, comparing and selecting suitable robotic systems and assist throughout the procurement process

• Lead the implementation of the selected system, including its configuration and the programming of automated workflows and procedures

Your profile

• Master’s degree in life sciences, engineering, or equivalent education

• At least 3 years of professional experience in programming and operating laboratory automation and liquid-handling systems, as well as in related quality management

• Experience in adapting and optimizing cell-based and in vitro assays

• Knowledge of mammalian cell culture systems and 3D cell cultures (organoids)

• Expertise in software such as R, KNIME or Python

• An independent, reliable and goal-oriented work style

• You are not afraid to take on responsibility, tackle new tasks and independently acquire the necessary expertise

• You have an open and communicative personality and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary environment

• Good oral and written proficiency in German and English is required: You must be fluent in everyday use of both languages

Our offer

• A challenging and varied role in the field of cutting-edge international research

• Progressive working conditions, an open work environment, excellent opportunities for professional development and a modern workplace in St. Gallen

• Initial 2-year fixed-term position—with the possibility of extension

• Flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, knowledge exchange, working together in a team

• Ideal starting date: 1 November 2026 or upon agreement

We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's what counts.

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, reporting on 1 - 2 representative tasks / experiences supporting your skills (see application process), CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered.

Systemtechniker Zellkultur Automation 80 - 100%

Die Abteilung Nanomaterialien im Gesundheitswesen der Empa St. Gallen ist ein hochmotiviertes Team aus Biologen, Chemikern und Bioinformatikern. descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi siamo

La scienza e la tecnologia dei materiali sono la nostra passione. Con la nostra ricerca all'avanguardia, i circa 1.100 collaboratori dell'Empa danno un contributo decisivo al benessere della società e ad un futuro degno di essere vissuto. L'Empa è un istituto di ricerca del settore dei PF.

Apprendista assistente di laboratorio EFZ con specializzazione nel settore tessile (a)

Per noi è particolarmente importante una formazione professionale versatile e pratica. Con noi non solo impari il tuo mestiere, ma lavori anche attivamente in un ambiente di ricerca innovativo. Un apprendistato di successo all'Empa richiede motivazione, iniziativa e flessibilità.

Indipendenza, senso di responsabilità, creatività e pensiero in rete ti accompagneranno durante tutta la tua formazione. Con il nostro programma di supporto interno “Saphir” vi forniamo ulteriore supporto mirato nel vostro sviluppo. Se sei curioso, ti piace lavorare sulle tecnologie del futuro e trovi interessante la ricerca, non vediamo l'ora di conoscerti.

Compiti

- I tecnici di laboratorio EFZ Textil imparano non solo come maneggiare in sicurezza i prodotti chimici, ma anche i processi tecnici e di tintura.
- I corsi introduttivi esterni specifici per il settore chimico e tessile supportano il trasferimento di conoscenze durante la formazione.
- Lavori su progetti di ricerca e impari a pianificare e realizzare esperimenti in laboratorio e valutare i risultati.
- La registrazione degli esperimenti è una parte centrale del lavoro quotidiano.
- Oltre alla formazione interna, frequenterai il Centro commerciale di formazione professionale e perfezionamento di San Gallo (GBS).

Requisiti

- Hai conseguito il diploma di scuola secondaria superiore con buoni risultati in matematica, fisica, chimica e inglese.
- Hai una buona visione dei colori.
- Hai la volontà di imparare ed esibirti.
- Per te è molto importante pensare in rete e un modo di lavorare preciso e affidabile.
- Ti piace lavorare al PC e hai molta perseveranza per gli esperimenti che non funzionano subito.

Offriamo

- Offriamo una formazione interessante, un ambiente di lavoro moderno e ottime condizioni di lavoro.
- Con noi hai l'opportunità di acquisire una vasta gamma di conoscenze.
- L'Empa è un ambiente di ricerca vivace e innovativo con un tocco internazionale.
- Puoi trovare ulteriori informazioni sull'insegnamento dell'Empa nella nostra scheda informativa e sulla nostra homepage.

Nei nostri annunci di lavoro “a” sta per “all”. Viviamo una cultura di inclusione e rispetto. Diamo il benvenuto a tutte le persone interessate ad attività innovative, sostenibili e significative: questo è tutto ciò che conta.

Contatto

Saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura online completa, inclusa una lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, test della cabina di segnalazione e dettagli di contatto per due referenze. Si prega di inviare questi documenti esclusivamente tramite il nostro portale di candidatura. Non verranno prese in considerazione candidature inviate via e-mail o posta.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About us

Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's approximately 1,100 employees make crucial contributions to the well-being of society and to a future worth living. Empa is a research institution in the ETH domain.

Apprentice laboratory assistant EFZ specializing in textiles (a)

Versatile and practical vocational training is particularly important to us. With us you not only learn your craft, but also work actively in an innovative research environment. A successful apprenticeship at Empa requires motivation, initiative and flexibility.

Independence, a sense of responsibility, creativity and networked thinking accompany you throughout your entire training. With our internal “Saphir” support program, we provide you with additional targeted support in your development. If you are curious, enjoy working on future technologies and find research exciting, we look forward to getting to know you.

Tasks

- EFZ Textil laboratory technicians learn not only how to safely handle chemicals, but also technical and dyeing processes.
- External chemical and textile-specific introductory courses support the transfer of knowledge during your training.
- You work on research projects and learn to plan and carry out experiments in the laboratory and evaluate the results.
- Recording experiments is a central part of daily work.
- In addition to in-house training, you will attend the St. Gallen Commercial Vocational and Further Training Center (GBS).

Requirements

- You graduated from secondary school with good results in mathematics, physics, chemistry and English.
- You have good color vision.
- You have a willingness to learn and perform.
- Networked thinking and an exact and reliable way of working are very important to you.
- You like working on the PC and have a lot of perseverance for experiments that don't work right away.

We offer

- We offer interesting training, a modern workplace and excellent employment conditions.
- With us you have the opportunity to acquire a wide range of knowledge.
- Empa is a lively and innovative research environment with an international flair.
- You can find further information about Empa's teaching in our fact sheet and on our homepage.

“a” stands for “all” in our job advertisements. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are interested in innovative, sustainable and meaningful activities - that's all that counts.

Contact

We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, signal box test and contact details for two references. Please submit these documents exclusively via our application portal. Applications by email or post will not be considered.

Lavorare in un istituto di ricerca ETH porta molta varietà al vostro lavoro quotidiano. Se siete interessati a fisica, elettronica, tecnologia e materiali, vi garantiamo compiti entusiasmanti in un ambiente di ricerca internazionale. Amate anche tinkering e lavori.

Material science and technology are our passion. With our top-level research, the approximately 1,100 employees of Empa make a decisive contribution to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH division.

Trainee in physics laboratory (a)

For August 2027, we offer a challenging training place in a fascinating research environment in the Materials and Nanomechanics department in Thun.

What awaits you

Working at an ETH research institute brings a lot of variety to your everyday work. If you are interested in physics, electronics, technology and materials, we guarantee you exciting tasks in an international research environment. You also love tinkering and works.

What do you bring with you?

• Secondary school A with very good performance in the scientific, mathematical and linguistic subjects - English is our everyday language

• Theoretical and practical interest in physics, chemistry, materials, electronics, computer science and technical systems

• Abstract thinking and methodical approach, technical understanding and manual skill

• Good monitoring and understanding, care, responsible and reliable work

• Enjoying a highly technical and complex working environment

• High skills in communication and cooperation with people You are also convinced that you will start your future with a professional apprenticeship.

What we offer you

• You will examine the physical and chemical integrity of metallic materials and their components, such as those used in buildings, bridges, tunnels, production plants, mechanical engineering, energy, railway and medical technology

• You can determine material characteristics using the most modern analytical methods and perform physical measurements and test series with materials and systems

• You will design, prepare, perform and document test equipment

• You are visiting the vocational school in Zurich. BMS is supported. We offer an exciting and versatile basic training with the most modern technology. Empa is a lively and innovative research environment with an international flair and excellent employment conditions in the Agglomeration of Zurich.

"a" stands for "all" in our job listings. We live a culture of inclusion and respect. We welcome all people who are in the mood for innovative, sustainable and sun-drenched activities – that's all that counts.

We look forward to your complete online application including motivational letters, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit them exclusively via our application portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be taken into account.

« a » signifie « tous » dans nos listes de postes. Nous vivons une culture d'inclusion et de respect. Nous accueillons toutes les personnes qui sont d'humeur à des activités innovantes, durables et ensoleillées – c'est tout ce qui compte.

Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature complète en ligne, y compris les lettres de motivation, CV, certificats, diplômes et coordonnées de deux personnes de référence. Veuillez les soumettre exclusivement via notre portail d'applications. Les candidatures par e-mail et par la poste ne seront pas prises en compte.
